literature.headline_zh: 麻疹病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 通过咽拭子中的实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测 麻疹病毒 RNA。患者出现发烧和头尾斑丘疹,随后出现进行性全身和呼吸道症状,包括咳嗽、咽炎和轻微呼吸疼痛。通过支持治疗,氧合作用迅速改善,并且没有并发症或继发病例记录。 [10.12659/ajcr.954333]
宾夕法尼亚州 1,400 多例 麻疹 确诊病例中有 4 例是接种疫苗的个体,阿勒格尼县 93.8% 的儿童已完全接种 麻疹 疫苗,一些社区低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值。 [10.64628/aai.urq9hvnxa]
筛查系统成功实施,将筛查阳性率降低至每 1000 次遇到 0.12 例。 [10.1016/j.ajic.2026.10.022]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab. The patient developed fever and a cephalocaudal maculopapular rash, followed by progressive systemic and respiratory symptoms, including cough, pharyngitis, and mild pain on breathing. [10.12659/ajcr.954333]
Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2750748]

In the cross-sectional analysis, measles seropositivity did not statistically differ after 6-12 months of cART by age at initiation (0-8: 30.8% [n=12/39]; 9-23: 37.0% [n=51/138]; 24-59 months: 26.6% [n=33/124]). [10.1097/qai.0000000000003999]

Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were among vaccinated individuals, and 93.8% of children in Allegheny County are fully vaccinated against measles, with some neighborhoods below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity. [10.64628/aai.urq9hvnxa]
The screening system was successfully implemented, reducing screening positivity to 0.12 per 1000 encounters. [10.1016/j.ajic.2026.10.022]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.
literature.brief_en: This literature brief prioritizes papers published in the active reporting window and ranks them by relevance, evidence availability, study quality, recency, and independent-source convergence. Detailed study-specific evidence is retained in the article cards below.
brief_items_zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
通过咽拭子中的实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测 麻疹病毒 RNA。患者出现发烧和头尾斑丘疹,随后出现进行性全身和呼吸道症状,包括咳嗽、咽炎和轻微呼吸疼痛。通过支持治疗,氧合作用迅速改善,并且没有并发症或继发病例记录。
宾夕法尼亚州 1,400 多例 麻疹 确诊病例中有 4 例是接种疫苗的个体,阿勒格尼县 93.8% 的儿童已完全接种 麻疹 疫苗,一些社区低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值。 [10.64628/aai.urq9hvnxa]。
brief_items_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab.
Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2750748].

In the cross-sectional analysis, measles seropositivity did not statistically differ after 6-12 months of cART by age at initiation (0-8: 30.8% [n=12/39]; 9-23: 37.0% [n=51/138]; 24-59 months: 26.6% [n=33/124]).

Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were among vaccinated individuals, and 93.8% of children in Allegheny County are fully vaccinated against measles, with some neighborhoods below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity.
literature.zh: 本期麻疹病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。；通过咽拭子中的实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测 麻疹病毒 RNA。患者出现发烧和头尾斑丘疹,随后出现进行性全身和呼吸道症状,包括咳嗽、咽炎和轻微呼吸疼痛。通过支持治疗,氧合作用迅速改善,并且没有并发症或继发病例记录。；麻疹 血清流行率 在1-5岁、6-15岁、16-40岁和>40岁年龄组中分别从2013年的33%、41%、47%和48%增加到2022年的77%、71%、89%和96%。 [10.1080/21645515.2026.2750748]。；在横断面分析中,cART 6-12 个月后,麻疹 血清阳性率按开始年龄划分没有统计学差异(0-8 个月:30.8% [n=12/39];9-23 个月:37.0% [n=51/138];24-59 个月:26.6% [n=33/124])。；宾夕法尼亚州 1,400 多例 麻疹 确诊病例中有 4 例是接种疫苗的个体,阿勒格尼县 93.8% 的儿童已完全接种 麻疹 疫苗,一些社区低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值。 [10.64628/aai.urq9hvnxa]。
literature.en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments. Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab. Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2750748]. In the cross-sectional analysis, measles seropositivity did not statistically differ after 6-12 months of cART by age at initiation (0-8: 30.8% [n=12/39]; 9-23: 37.0% [n=51/138]; 24-59 months: 26.6% [n=33/124]). Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were among vaccinated individuals, and 93.8% of children in Allegheny County are fully vaccinated against measles, with some neighborhoods below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity.

papers.title: Measles made a stealthy return as another virus took the spotlight.
papers.abstract: Measles is reemerging, with cases and outbreaks increasing across the United States and other countries where measles had previously been eliminated. physicians have no experience with treating measles. However, the increasing likelihood of encountering not only children but also adults with measles requires a clinical review of the epidemiology, prevention, diagnosis, and management of this previously uncommon infection for general internal medicine physicians and hospitalists who care for adults in settings with measles reemergence. Prompt clinical suspicion, infection control measures, and notification of public health departments support timely diagnosis and disease control.

papers.title: Timing of antiretroviral treatment initiation and seropositivity to measles virus among children living with HIV in rural Zambia.
papers.abstract: Background Combination antiretroviral therapy (cART) reduces morbidity among children living with HIV (CHIV) but does not restore vaccine-induced measles immunity. Many CHIV now initiate cART before measles vaccination but the impact on measles seroprevalence is not understood. This study compared measles seropositivty between CHIV initiating cART before and after 9 months in Zambia. Methods This retrospective study was nested within a cohort study of CHIV and community-based studies in Macha, Zambia conducted from 2007-2020. Samples were tested for measles IgG antibodies by enzyme immunoassay from CHIV initiating cART at ages 0-8, 9-23, and 24-59 months and age-matched community-based controls. A cross-sectional analysis compared measles seroprevalence between CHIV groups after 6-12 months of cART and controls. A longitudinal analysis evaluated antibody concentrations from age 9 months through 48 months of cART and during the 2010-11 measles outbreak. Results In the cross-sectional analysis, measles seropositivity did not statistically differ after 6-12 months of cART by age at initiation (0-8: 30.8% [n=12/39]; 9-23: 37.0% [n=51/138]; 24-59 months: 26.6% [n=33/124]). Within CHIV groups, seropositivity was significantly lower than age-matched controls (63.5%, 75.7%, and 80.3%). Among 242 CHIV followed longitudinally, 46-56% had an antibody response, with estimated seroreversion in only 1.8-3.2 years. Among CHIV in 2010-11, 50% seroconverted or boosted with estimated seroreversion in 2.1 years. Conclusions Measles seroprevalence was low among CHIV, even when starting cART before 9 months of age, and the time to seroreversion was short. These findings support recommendations that CHIV, including infants, would benefit from periodic revaccination after immune reconstitution.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of antiretroviral treatment (ART) initiation timing on measles seroprevalence among children living with HIV (CHIV) in rural Zambia. The research aimed to address the gap in understanding how early ART affects measles immunity, as cART reduces HIV-related morbidity but does not restore vaccine-induced immunity. A cross-sectional analysis compared seropositivity between CHIV who started ART before and after 9 months of age, alongside age-matched community controls. The results showed no significant difference in seropositivity by age at ART initiation, but seropositivity was lower in CHIV compared to controls. A longitudinal analysis revealed that antibody responses were common, with seroreversion occurring within 1.8-3.2 years. The authors concluded that measles seroprevalence remains low among CHIV, even when ART is initiated early, and that seroreversion occurs relatively quickly. These findings suggest that periodic revaccination may be necessary for CHIV to maintain measles immunity. The study's evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of detailed limitations.

A longitudinal analysis evaluated antibody concentrations from age 9 months through 48 months of cART and during the 2010-11 measles outbreak. Results In the cross-sectional analysis, measles seropositivity did not statistically differ after 6-12 months of cART by age at initiation (0-8: 30.8% [n=12/39]; 9-23: 37.0% [n=51/138]; 24-59 months: 26.6% [n=33/124]). Within CHIV groups, seropositivity was significantly lower than age-matched controls (63.5%, 75.7%, and 80.3%). Among 242 CHIV followed longitudinally, 46-56% had an antibody response, with estimated seroreversion in only 1.8-3.2 years. Among CHIV in 2010-11, 50% seroconverted or boosted with estimated seroreversion in 2.1 years. Conclusions Measles seroprevalence was low among CHIV, even when starting cART before 9 months of age, and the time to seroreversion was short. These findings support recommendations that CHIV, including infants, would benefit from periodic revaccination after immune reconstitution.

papers.title: Vaccine-Induced Antibody and T Cell Immunity to Measles and Varicella in Children With ALL.
papers.abstract: Abstract Children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) are treated with multiagent chemotherapy that causes profound changes to the immune system. There are limited data on how disease and therapy impact antigen-specific immune memory, leading to inconsistent guidelines on best practices for revaccination of this population. Here, to inform vaccine guidance, we investigated whether immunity derived from routine childhood measles and varicella zoster virus (VZV) vaccines is maintained during and after therapy for childhood ALL. We report that antibodies against measles and VZV were significantly reduced in children with ALL (n=45) compared to healthy controls (n=13), particularly in older children in whom a longer time had passed since their most recent vaccine dose. However, the avidity of the measles and VZV-specific antibodies was indistinguishable between groups. Despite changes to the composition of the T cell compartment, both overall and antigen-specific T cell function were preserved in children with ALL. These data provide compelling evidence for revaccination of children following ALL treatment. Intact T cell responses suggest that post-treatment revaccination would be effective.

papers.title: Population level immunity to measles and rubella 5 years before and after the MR campaign in urban Vellore, South India.
papers.abstract: India aims to eliminate measles and rubella (MR) by 2026. Despite >90% vaccination coverage reported in NFHS-5 and NFHS-6, assessing population-level immunity gaps remains essential to guide strategies for protecting vulnerable groups. We leveraged biobanked samples from two community-based serosurveys conducted in urban Vellore in 2013 and 2022, representing periods 5 years before and after the nationwide MR vaccination campaign. Age- and sex-stratified participants were tested for measles- and rubella-specific IgG antibodies using ELISA. Seroprevalence estimates were compared across surveys, and generalized additive models (GAM) were used to assess age-specific seropositivity patterns. Effective reproduction numbers (Re) for measles and rubella were estimated using mixture modeling approaches. A total of 1,029 samples from 2013 and 718 samples from 2022 were analyzed. Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. Rubella seroprevalence increased from 32%, 67%, 76%, and 73% to 93%, 84%, 93%, and 98% across the same age groups. No significant sex-based differences were observed for either infection. The estimated Re declined from 7.4 to 3.6 for measles and from 1.8 to 0.8 for rubella following the MR campaign period. Population immunity improved by 2022, particularly for rubella. However, lower measles seroprevalence among children aged 1-15 years indicates persistent immunity gaps despite high vaccine coverage, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and targeted strategies to achieve measles-rubella elimination in India.

papers.title_zh: 印度南部韦洛尔市 MR 运动前后 5 年的人群对 麻疹 和风疹的免疫力。
papers.source_body_en: India aims to eliminate measles and rubella (MR) by 2026. Despite >90% vaccination coverage reported in NFHS-5 and NFHS-6, assessing population-level immunity gaps remains essential to guide strategies for protecting vulnerable groups. We leveraged biobanked samples from two community-based serosurveys conducted in urban Vellore in 2013 and 2022, representing periods 5 years before and after the nationwide MR vaccination campaign. Age- and sex-stratified participants were tested for measles- and rubella-specific IgG antibodies using ELISA. Seroprevalence estimates were compared across surveys, and generalized additive models (GAM) were used to assess age-specific seropositivity patterns. Effective reproduction numbers (Re) for measles and rubella were estimated using mixture modeling approaches. A total of 1,029 samples from 2013 and 718 samples from 2022 were analyzed. Measles seroprevalence increased from 33%, 41%, 47%, and 48% in the 1-5, 6-15, 16-40, and >40 years age groups in 2013 to 77%, 71%, 89%, and 96% respectively in 2022. Rubella seroprevalence increased from 32%, 67%, 76%, and 73% to 93%, 84%, 93%, and 98% across the same age groups. No significant sex-based differences were observed for either infection. The estimated Re declined from 7.4 to 3.6 for measles and from 1.8 to 0.8 for rubella following the MR campaign period. Population immunity improved by 2022, particularly for rubella. However, lower measles seroprevalence among children aged 1-15 years indicates persistent immunity gaps despite high vaccine coverage, highlighting the need for continued surveillance and targeted strategies to achieve measles-rubella elimination in India.
papers.abstract_zh: 印度的目标是到 2026 年消除 麻疹 和风疹 (MR)。尽管 NFHS-5 和 NFHS-6 报告的 麻疹 覆盖率超过 90%,但评估人群水平的免疫差距对于指导保护弱势群体的策略仍然至关重要。我们利用了 2013 年和 2022 年在韦洛尔市进行的两次基于社区的血清调查的生物样本库样本,代表了全国 MR 疫苗接种 运动前后 5 年的时期。使用 ELISA 对年龄和性别分层的参与者进行 麻疹 和风疹特异性 IgG 抗体检测。对各项调查中的 血清流行率 估计值进行比较,并使用广义加性模型 (GAM) 来评估特定年龄的血清阳性模式。使用混合建模方法估计 麻疹 和风疹的有效繁殖数 (Re)。总共分析了 2013 年的 1,029 个样本和 2022 年的 718 个样本。麻疹 血清流行率 在 1-5、6-15、16-40 和 >40 岁年龄组中分别从 2013 年的 33%、41%、47% 和 48% 增加到 2022 年的 77%、71%、89% 和 96%。风疹 血清流行率 从同一年龄组中这一比例为 32%、67%、76% 和 73% 至 93%、84%、93% 和 98%。两种感染均未观察到显着的性别差异。MR 活动期后,麻疹 的估计 Re 从 7.4 下降至 3.6,风疹的估计 Re 从 1.8 下降至 0.8。到 2022 年,人口免疫力得到改善,尤其是风疹免疫力。然而,1-15 岁儿童中较低的 麻疹 血清流行率 表明,尽管 疫苗 覆盖率较高,但仍存在持续的免疫缺口,这凸显了印度需要持续的 麻疹 和有针对性的策略来实现 麻疹 风疹消除。

papers.title: Measles Screening at Registration Using an Electronic Medical Record-Based System.
papers.abstract: A pediatric healthcare system located near a 2025 measles regional outbreak shares processes for developing electronic medical records-based measles screening at registration to promptly identify patients at high risk of measles and prevent secondary exposures. Buy-in was gained from stakeholders concerned about slowed registration and limited numbers of airborne isolation rooms by reporting registration times and fine-tuning screening to reduce screening positivity iteratively to rates as low as 0.12 per 1000 encounters.

papers.title: Canada’s loss of measles elimination after 27 years: a mathematical modelling analysis of the five major provincial outbreak waves in 2025–2026
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Canada’s loss of measles elimination status in 2025 highlighted the vulnerability of populations with concentrated immunity gaps. Provincial incidence alone cannot readily distinguish relatively intense transmission within a small susceptible population from transmission involving a larger population. We quantified these differences across five provincial measles waves in 2025-2026. Methods We fitted a common susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered (SEIR) model to weekly reported measles incidence for Ontario in 2025 and Alberta and Manitoba in 2025 and 2026. Mean latent and infectious periods were fixed at 10 and 8 days. We estimated the effective reproduction number ( R eff , 0 ), effective susceptible population ( S eff , 0 ), and profiled the initial infected number to evaluate province and wave-specific primary case model estimates. We calculate the initial exponential growth rate, doubling time, and peak full width at half maximum (FWHM) to characterize early epidemic growth and the duration of elevated incidence around each wave’s peak. Findings In 2025, Ontario’s effective reproduction number, R eff , 0 , was 1.9, with a model-estimated effective susceptible population, S eff , 0 , of 3,101 individuals, an initial doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and a peak FWHM of 12.3 weeks. Alberta had a similar R eff , 0 of 1.9, with S eff , 0 of 2,601 individuals, a doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and FWHM of 12.1 weeks. Manitoba had a lower R eff , 0 of 1.5 and S eff , 0 of 490 individuals, with a longer doubling time of 4.0 weeks and FWHM of 20.5 weeks. In 2026, Alberta’s R eff , 0 increased to 2.1 while S eff , 0 decreased to 383 individuals; doubling time shortened to 2.1 weeks and FWHM to 9.7 weeks. Manitoba’s R eff , 0 increased to 1.8 and S eff , 0 to 1,038 individuals, while doubling time shortened to 2.6 weeks and FWHM to 13.0 weeks. Interpretation Alberta’s smaller second wave combined the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, demonstrating that limited outbreak size can coexist with rapid transmission. Joint estimates of transmission intensity, epidemic pace, peak duration, and effective susceptible population provide complementary measures for comparing outbreaks and informing public-health planning. Together, these estimates provide a quantitative basis for distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement, supporting comparisons across outbreaks and informing the timing and scale of public-health responses for future outbreaks.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the loss of measles elimination status in Canada by quantifying the differences in transmission intensity and scale across five provincial measles waves in 2025-2026. The vulnerability of populations with concentrated immunity gaps was highlighted.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used a common susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered (SEIR) model to fit weekly reported measles incidence data from Ontario in 2025 and from Alberta and Manitoba in 2025 and 2026.
analysis.methods: The SEIR model was fitted to weekly reported measles incidence data, with fixed mean latent and infectious periods of 10 and 8 days, respectively. The effective reproduction number (R_eff,0), effective susceptible population (S_eff,0), and initial infected number were estimated to evaluate province and wave-specific primary case model estimates.
analysis.main_results: Ontario had an R_eff,0 of 1.9 with 3,101 effective susceptible individuals, a doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and a peak FWHM of 12.3 weeks. Alberta and Manitoba had similar R_eff,0 values of 1.9 and 1.5, respectively, with varying effective susceptible populations and doubling times. In 2026, Alberta’s R_eff,0 increased to 2.1, while Manitoba’s increased to 1.8.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Alberta’s smaller second wave had the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, demonstrating that limited outbreak size can coexist with rapid transmission. Joint estimates of transmission intensity, epidemic pace, peak duration, and effective susceptible population provide complementary measures for comparing outbreaks and informing public-health planning.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These estimates provide a quantitative basis for distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement, supporting comparisons across outbreaks and informing the timing and scale of public-health responses for future outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s design limitations include the use of a common SEIR model across different provinces and the fixed mean latent and infectious periods. The evidence strength is moderate, as the model estimates are based on reported incidence data and do not account for all potential confounding factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study used a SEIR model to analyze five provincial measles waves in Canada, quantifying transmission intensity and scale. Alberta’s smaller second wave had the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, highlighting the importance of distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement.

elements_zh.methods: SEIR 模型适合每周报告的 麻疹 发病率 数据,固定平均潜伏期和感染期分别为 10 天和 8 天。估计有效繁殖数 (R_eff,0)、有效易感人群 (S_eff,0) 和初始感染数,以评估省份和特定波次的原发病例模型估计。

analysis_en.main_results: Ontario had an R_eff,0 of 1.9 with 3,101 effective susceptible individuals, a doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and a peak FWHM of 12.3 weeks. Alberta and Manitoba had similar R_eff,0 values of 1.9 and 1.5, respectively, with varying effective susceptible populations and doubling times. In 2026, Alberta’s R_eff,0 increased to 2.1, while Manitoba’s increased to 1.8.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Alberta’s smaller second wave had the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, demonstrating that limited outbreak size can coexist with rapid transmission. Joint estimates of transmission intensity, epidemic pace, peak duration, and effective susceptible population provide complementary measures for comparing outbreaks and informing public-health planning.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These estimates provide a quantitative basis for distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement, supporting comparisons across outbreaks and informing the timing and scale of public-health responses for future outbreaks.

papers.title_zh: 加拿大27年后麻疹淘汰失利:2025-2026年五大省麻疹浪潮的数学模型分析
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Canada’s loss of measles elimination status in 2025 highlighted the vulnerability of populations with concentrated immunity gaps. Provincial incidence alone cannot readily distinguish relatively intense transmission within a small susceptible population from transmission involving a larger population. We quantified these differences across five provincial measles waves in 2025-2026. Methods We fitted a common susceptible–exposed–infectious–recovered (SEIR) model to weekly reported measles incidence for Ontario in 2025 and Alberta and Manitoba in 2025 and 2026. Mean latent and infectious periods were fixed at 10 and 8 days. We estimated the effective reproduction number ( R eff , 0 ), effective susceptible population ( S eff , 0 ), and profiled the initial infected number to evaluate province and wave-specific primary case model estimates. We calculate the initial exponential growth rate, doubling time, and peak full width at half maximum (FWHM) to characterize early epidemic growth and the duration of elevated incidence around each wave’s peak. Findings In 2025, Ontario’s effective reproduction number, R eff , 0 , was 1.9, with a model-estimated effective susceptible population, S eff , 0 , of 3,101 individuals, an initial doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and a peak FWHM of 12.3 weeks. Alberta had a similar R eff , 0 of 1.9, with S eff , 0 of 2,601 individuals, a doubling time of 2.4 weeks, and FWHM of 12.1 weeks. Manitoba had a lower R eff , 0 of 1.5 and S eff , 0 of 490 individuals, with a longer doubling time of 4.0 weeks and FWHM of 20.5 weeks. In 2026, Alberta’s R eff , 0 increased to 2.1 while S eff , 0 decreased to 383 individuals; doubling time shortened to 2.1 weeks and FWHM to 9.7 weeks. Manitoba’s R eff , 0 increased to 1.8 and S eff , 0 to 1,038 individuals, while doubling time shortened to 2.6 weeks and FWHM to 13.0 weeks. Interpretation Alberta’s smaller second wave combined the highest effective reproduction number with the shortest doubling time and peak duration, demonstrating that limited outbreak size can coexist with rapid transmission. Joint estimates of transmission intensity, epidemic pace, peak duration, and effective susceptible population provide complementary measures for comparing outbreaks and informing public-health planning. Together, these estimates provide a quantitative basis for distinguishing transmission intensity from the scale of susceptible involvement, supporting comparisons across outbreaks and informing the timing and scale of public-health responses for future outbreaks.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 加拿大在 2025 年丧失 麻疹 消除状态凸显了免疫缺口集中的人群的脆弱性。仅省级 发病率 无法轻易地区分少数易感人群中相对强烈的 传播 和涉及较大人群的 传播。我们量化了 2025-2026 年五个省 麻疹 波中的这些差异。方法 我们将常见的易感者-暴露-感染-恢复 (SEIR) 模型与 2025 年安大略省以及 2025 年和 2026 年阿尔伯塔省和马尼托巴省每周报告的 麻疹 发病率 进行拟合。平均潜伏期和感染期固定为 10 天和 8 天。我们估计了有效传染数 ( R eff,0 )、有效易感人群 ( S eff,0 ),并分析了初始感染人数,以评估省份和特定波次的主要病例模型估计。我们计算初始指数增长率、倍增时间和半峰全宽 (FWHM),以表征早期流行病增长以及每波峰值周围 发病率 升高的持续时间。研究结果 2025 年,安大略省的有效繁殖数 R eff,0 为 1.9,模型估计的有效易感人群 S eff,0 为 3,101 人,初始倍增时间为 2.4 周,峰值半高宽为 12.3 周。艾伯塔省的 R eff 为 0,为 1.9,S eff 为 0,为 2,601 人,倍增时间为 2.4 周,FWHM 为 12.1 周。马尼托巴省的 R eff 为 1.5,S eff 为 0,为 1.5,S eff 为 0,为 490 人,倍增时间较长,为 4.0 周,半高宽为 20.5 周。2026年,艾伯塔省的R eff,0 增加至2.1,而S eff,0 减少至383人;倍增时间缩短至 2.1 周,半高宽缩短至 9.7 周。马尼托巴省的 R eff,0 增加至 1.8,S eff,0 增加至 1,038 个体,而倍增时间缩短至 2.6 周,FWHM 缩短至 13.0 周。阿尔伯塔省较小的第二波将最高的有效繁殖数与最短的倍增时间和峰值持续时间结合在一起,表明有限的 暴发 大小可以与快速的 传播 共存。对 传播 强度、流行速度、高峰持续时间和有效易感人群的联合估计为比较 传播 和为公共卫生规划提供信息提供了补充措施。总之,这些估计为区分 传播 强度与易感性参与规模提供了定量基础,支持 暴发 之间的比较,并告知未来 传播 公共卫生应对的时间和规模。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过量化 2025-2026 年五个省 麻疹 浪潮中 麻疹 强度和规模的差异,了解加拿大 麻疹 消除状况的丧失。强调了免疫缺口集中的人群的脆弱性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用常见的易感者-暴露-感染-恢复 (SEIR) 模型来拟合 2025 年安大略省以及 2025 年和 2026 年阿尔伯塔省和马尼托巴省每周报告的 麻疹 发病率 数据。
analysis_zh.methods: SEIR 模型适合每周报告的 麻疹 发病率 数据,固定平均潜伏期和感染期分别为 10 天和 8 天。估计有效繁殖数 (R_eff,0)、有效易感人群 (S_eff,0) 和初始感染数,以评估省份和特定波次的原发病例模型估计。
analysis_zh.main_results: 安大略省的 R_eff,0 为 1.9,有 3,101 名有效易感个体,倍增时间为 2.4 周,峰值 FWHM 为 12.3 周。阿尔伯塔省和曼尼托巴省的 R_eff,0 值相似,分别为 1.9 和 1.5,但有效易感人群和倍增时间各不相同。2026 年,阿尔伯塔省的 R_eff,0 增加到 2.1,而曼尼托巴省则增加到 1.8。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 阿尔伯塔省较小的第二波具有最高的有效繁殖数、最短的倍增时间和峰值持续时间,这表明有限的 暴发 大小可以与快速的 传播 共存。对 传播 强度、流行速度、高峰持续时间和有效易感人群的联合估计为比较 传播 和为公共卫生规划提供信息提供了补充措施。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些估计为区分 传播 强度与易感性参与规模提供了定量基础,支持 传播 之间的比较,并告知未来 传播 公共卫生应对的时间和规模。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的设计局限性包括在不同省份使用通用的 SEIR 模型以及固定的平均潜伏期和传染期。证据强度中等,因为模型估计基于报告的 发病率 数据,并且没有考虑所有潜在的混杂因素。

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.title: Protracted measles outbreak in a refugee-hosting setting in Kamwenge District, Uganda, 2025
papers.abstract: Measles outbreaks continue to occur in Uganda despite measles-rubella (MR) vaccination. On 24 June 2025, Kamwenge District, a refugee-hosting area, reported three laboratory-confirmed measles cases. We investigated the outbreak to determine its magnitude, identify risk factors, and estimate vaccine effectiveness (VE), and vaccination coverage (VC). A suspected case was fever and generalized maculopapular rash with ≥ 1 of cough, coryza, or conjunctivitis among Kamwenge residents from 1 February to 7 July 2025; a confirmed case had measles-specific IgM. Cases were identified through health-facility records and community searches. We calculated attack rates (AR), conducted environmental assessments, and performed an age-matched case-control study using neighborhood controls. Conditional logistic regression estimated adjusted odds ratios (aORs). VE was calculated as (1−OR_ M−H )×100; VC was the proportion of vaccinated eligible controls. We identified 109 cases (3 confirmed, 106 suspected); no deaths occurred. Of the cases, 48.6% were refugees. Overall AR was 3.2/10,000, highest among children aged 9–17 months (30.8/10,000) and refugees (13.3/10,000). Among 73 cases and 167 controls, attending a place of worship was associated with infection (aOR = 11.1; 95% CI 3.5–35.1), while MR1 (aOR = 0.3; 95% CI 0.1–0.7) and MR2 (aOR = 0.05; 95% CI 0.01–0.3) were protective. VE was 93% for MR1 and 95% for MR2. Coverage among eligible controls was 67% for MR1 and 36% for MR2. A prolonged outbreak occurred amid low MR coverage and high-contact social mixing. Strengthening routine two-dose vaccination, targeted vaccination in refugee-hosting communities, and prompt isolation of suspected cases may help prevent future outbreaks.

The results suggest that improving MR vaccination rates and implementing targeted strategies in refugee-hosting communities could help prevent future outbreaks. analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管 麻疹-风疹 (MR) 疫苗接种,麻疹 暴发 继续在乌干达发生。该研究旨在调查 暴发 以确定其大小、识别风险因素并估计 疫苗 有效性 (VE) 和 疫苗接种 覆盖范围 (VC)。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2025 年 2 月 1 日至 7 月 7 日在难民收容区 Kamwenge 区进行。研究涉及 73 例病例和 167 例对照,病例是通过卫生设施记录和社区搜索发现的。
analysis_zh.methods: 条件逻辑回归估计调整优势比 (aOR)。该研究计算了发病率(AR),进行了环境评估,并使用邻里对照进行了年龄匹配的病例对照研究。
analysis_zh.main_results: 我们发现了 109 例病例(3 例确诊,106 例疑似);没有发生死亡事件。在病例和对照中,参加礼拜场所与感染相关(aOR = 11.1;95% CI 3.5-35.1),而 MR1(aOR = 0.3;95% CI 0.1-0.7)和 MR2(aOR = 0.05;95% CI 0.01-0.3)具有保护性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了社会混合和低 疫苗接种 覆盖率在维持 麻疹 暴发 中的作用。该研究为 MR 疫苗 在难民收容社区中的有效性提供了新颖的见解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,在难民收容社区加强常规两剂 疫苗接种 和针对性 疫苗接种 可能有助于预防未来的 暴发。迅速隔离疑似病例也被强调为一项重要的公共卫生措施。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据因其对卫生设施记录和社区搜索的依赖而受到限制,这可能会引入回忆偏差。由于可能存在漏报和样本量较小,因此调查结果的可信度为中等。

papers.title: Zero-dose children and measles risk in Punjab, Pakistan: magnitude, geographic distribution, and programmatic implications, 2022–2026
papers.abstract: Background Zero-dose children, defined by absence of a first diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis-containing dose, are the priority of the Immunization Agenda 2030. Measles cases include many unvaccinated children, but those too young for vaccination are rarely separated from those the programme could have reached. We describe the magnitude, age, and geographic distribution of measles zero-dose status among confirmed cases in Punjab, Pakistan. Methods We analysed 19,569 laboratory-confirmed and epidemiologically linked measles cases among 73,223 surveillance records, epidemiological week 1 of 2022 to week 25 of 2026. Measles zero-dose meant no measles-containing dose through routine or campaign immunization. Cases were split into vaccine-ineligible (under 9 months) and eligible (9 months or older). Analyses included trend tests, Spearman correlation, and adjusted Poisson regression. Results Of 19,569 cases, 9706 (50%) were zero-dose, and 5740 of these (59%) were infants under 9 months. Among 13,825 vaccine-eligible cases, 3963 (29%; 95% CI 28–29) were zero-dose: 21% in 2022, 40% in 2024, and 17% in 2026. Dera Ghazi Khan (59%) and Lodhran (52%) had the highest district shares, unrelated to administrative MCV1 coverage (rho = −0.24, p = 0.15). Case fatality was 0.71% in zero-dose and 0.26% in vaccinated eligible cases (adjusted relative risk 2.65, 95% CI 1.52–4.60). Conclusions About three in ten cases were too young for vaccination, and about three in ten of the rest had never received a measles dose. Cases over-represent unvaccinated children, so these proportions guide field investigation, not prevalence. District prioritisation should combine counts and proportions, not administrative coverage.

papers.title_zh: 巴基斯坦旁遮普邦的零剂量儿童和 麻疹 风险:程度、地理分布和规划影响,2022-2026 年
papers.source_body_en: Background Zero-dose children, defined by absence of a first diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis-containing dose, are the priority of the Immunization Agenda 2030. Measles cases include many unvaccinated children, but those too young for vaccination are rarely separated from those the programme could have reached. We describe the magnitude, age, and geographic distribution of measles zero-dose status among confirmed cases in Punjab, Pakistan. Methods We analysed 19,569 laboratory-confirmed and epidemiologically linked measles cases among 73,223 surveillance records, epidemiological week 1 of 2022 to week 25 of 2026. Measles zero-dose meant no measles-containing dose through routine or campaign immunization. Cases were split into vaccine-ineligible (under 9 months) and eligible (9 months or older). Analyses included trend tests, Spearman correlation, and adjusted Poisson regression. Results Of 19,569 cases, 9706 (50%) were zero-dose, and 5740 of these (59%) were infants under 9 months. Among 13,825 vaccine-eligible cases, 3963 (29%; 95% CI 28–29) were zero-dose: 21% in 2022, 40% in 2024, and 17% in 2026. Dera Ghazi Khan (59%) and Lodhran (52%) had the highest district shares, unrelated to administrative MCV1 coverage (rho = −0.24, p = 0.15). Case fatality was 0.71% in zero-dose and 0.26% in vaccinated eligible cases (adjusted relative risk 2.65, 95% CI 1.52–4.60). Conclusions About three in ten cases were too young for vaccination, and about three in ten of the rest had never received a measles dose. Cases over-represent unvaccinated children, so these proportions guide field investigation, not prevalence. District prioritisation should combine counts and proportions, not administrative coverage.

papers.title: Prevalence of second-dose measles vaccination utilization and associated factors among MCV1-vaccinated children aged 15–36 months in Tocha Woreda, Dawuro Zone, Southwest Ethiopia, 2025
papers.abstract: Background Measles is a highly contagious viral disease and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children worldwide. Evidence regarding the utilization of the second dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV2) and its associated factors in Southwest Ethiopia remains limited. This study examined MCV2 utilization rates and the factors associated with its uptake in Tocha Woreda, Dawuro Zone. Methods A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 585 children aged 15–36 months who had received the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV1). Participants were selected using a multi-stage systematic sampling method. Data were collected through in-person interviews with mothers or caregivers, using a structured questionnaire administered via the Kobo Collect mobile application. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics. Bi-variable logistic regression identified candidate variables ( p < 0.25) for inclusion in a multivariable logistic regression model to identify independent predictors of MCV2 utilization. Statistical significance was defined as a p -value of <0.05. Multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors, and model fit was evaluated using the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test. Results Among the 585 children included (response rate: 94.4%), 67.2% (95% CI: 63–71%) received the second dose of measles vaccine. Urban residence [adjusted odds ratio (AOR) = 3.43; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.74–6.44], maternal or caregiver education at the college level or higher (AOR = 12.76; 95% CI: 4.39–20.64), participation in conferences for pregnant women (AOR = 2.25; 95% CI: 1.11–4.56), shorter vaccination waiting times (≤15 min: AOR = 4.28; 95% CI: 1.83–10.01; 15–30 min: AOR = 3.33; 95% CI: 1.35–8.16), and favorable caregiver attitudes (AOR = 6.05; 95% CI: 2.96–12.35) were significantly associated with MCV2 utilization. Conclusion MCV2 utilization in Tocha Woreda remains below the World Health Organization (WHO) target for measles elimination. Improving maternal education, strengthening conferences for pregnant women, reducing waiting times at vaccination sites, and enhancing caregiver attitudes are essential to increasing MCV2 coverage.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹 是一种高度传染性的病毒性疾病,也是全球儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因。关于在埃塞俄比亚西南部使用第二剂含有 麻疹 的 疫苗 (MCV2) 及其相关因素的证据仍然有限。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Measles is a highly contagious viral disease and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children worldwide. Evidence regarding the utilization of the second dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV2) and its associated factors in Southwest Ethiopia remains limited.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 585 children aged 15–36 months who had received the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV1). Participants were selected using a multi-stage systematic sampling method.
analysis_en.methods: Data were collected through in-person interviews with mothers or caregivers, using a structured questionnaire administered via the Kobo Collect mobile application. Bi-variable logistic regression identified candidate variables (p < 0.25) for inclusion in a multivariable logistic regression model to identify independent predictors of MCV2 utilization. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics. Multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors, and model fit was evaluated using the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test.
analysis_en.main_results: Among the 585 children included (response rate: 94.4%), 67.2% (95% CI: 63–71%) received the second dose of measles vaccine. Urban residence [adjusted odds ratio (AOR) = 3.43; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.74–6.44], maternal or caregiver education at the college level or higher (AOR = 12.76; 95% CI: 4.39–20.64), participation in conferences for pregnant women (AOR = 2.25; 95% CI: 1.11–4.56), shorter vaccination waiting times (≤15 min: AOR = 4.28; 95% CI: 1.83–10.01; 15–30 min: AOR = 3.33; 95% CI: 1.35–8.16), and favorable caregiver attitudes (AOR = 6.05; 95% CI: 2.96–12.35) were significantly associated with MCV2 utilization.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified factors significantly associated with MCV2 utilization, including urban residence, higher maternal education, participation in pregnant women conferences, shorter waiting times, and favorable caregiver attitudes. These findings highlight the importance of addressing these factors to improve vaccination coverage.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Improving maternal education, strengthening conferences for pregnant women, reducing waiting times at vaccination sites, and enhancing caregiver attitudes are essential to increasing MCV2 coverage. These findings can inform targeted public health interventions to improve measles vaccination rates in the region.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the reliance on self-reported data and the potential for confounding factors.

papers.title_zh: 2025 年埃塞俄比亚西南部达乌罗地区 Tocha Woreda 15-36 个月 MCV1 疫苗接种儿童第二剂 麻疹 患病率 的利用情况及相关因素
papers.source_body_en: Background Measles is a highly contagious viral disease and a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among children worldwide. Evidence regarding the utilization of the second dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV2) and its associated factors in Southwest Ethiopia remains limited. This study examined MCV2 utilization rates and the factors associated with its uptake in Tocha Woreda, Dawuro Zone. Methods A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 585 children aged 15–36 months who had received the first dose of the measles-containing vaccine (MCV1). Participants were selected using a multi-stage systematic sampling method. Data were collected through in-person interviews with mothers or caregivers, using a structured questionnaire administered via the Kobo Collect mobile application. Data were analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics. Bi-variable logistic regression identified candidate variables ( p < 0.25) for inclusion in a multivariable logistic regression model to identify independent predictors of MCV2 utilization. Statistical significance was defined as a p -value of <0.05. Multicollinearity was assessed using variance inflation factors, and model fit was evaluated using the Hosmer–Lemeshow goodness-of-fit test. Results Among the 585 children included (response rate: 94.4%), 67.2% (95% CI: 63–71%) received the second dose of measles vaccine. Urban residence [adjusted odds ratio (AOR) = 3.43; 95% confidence interval (CI): 1.74–6.44], maternal or caregiver education at the college level or higher (AOR = 12.76; 95% CI: 4.39–20.64), participation in conferences for pregnant women (AOR = 2.25; 95% CI: 1.11–4.56), shorter vaccination waiting times (≤15 min: AOR = 4.28; 95% CI: 1.83–10.01; 15–30 min: AOR = 3.33; 95% CI: 1.35–8.16), and favorable caregiver attitudes (AOR = 6.05; 95% CI: 2.96–12.35) were significantly associated with MCV2 utilization. Conclusion MCV2 utilization in Tocha Woreda remains below the World Health Organization (WHO) target for measles elimination. Improving maternal education, strengthening conferences for pregnant women, reducing waiting times at vaccination sites, and enhancing caregiver attitudes are essential to increasing MCV2 coverage.

papers.title: Analysis of a reaction-diffusion SVEIR model for measles geographic spread
papers.abstract: We formulate and analyze a deterministic reaction-diffusion SVEIR model for the geographic spread of measles, explicitly incorporating vaccination, vaccine efficacy, latency, recovery, demographic turnover, and spatial diffusion. The disease-free equilibrium and the basic reproduction number $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ are obtained using the next-generation matrix, and linear stability analysis identifies the invasion threshold and the critical spatial mode. Because the critical wavenumber is zero, a long-wavelength analysis is used to characterize slow spatial variation near the invasion front. A mathematical consistency check shows that the common-diffusion formulation does not support a finite-wavenumber Turing instability; the roll, square, and hexagonal modes are therefore presented only as generic pattern-theory modes rather than as patterns proved to arise from the present model. Numerical simulations illustrate spatiotemporal propagation and quantify the effects of vaccine efficacy, vaccination rate, and transmission intensity.

papers.title_zh: 麻疹 地理分布的反应扩散 SVEIR 模型分析
papers.source_body_en: We formulate and analyze a deterministic reaction-diffusion SVEIR model for the geographic spread of measles, explicitly incorporating vaccination, vaccine efficacy, latency, recovery, demographic turnover, and spatial diffusion. The disease-free equilibrium and the basic reproduction number $$\mathcal {R}_0$$ are obtained using the next-generation matrix, and linear stability analysis identifies the invasion threshold and the critical spatial mode. Because the critical wavenumber is zero, a long-wavelength analysis is used to characterize slow spatial variation near the invasion front. A mathematical consistency check shows that the common-diffusion formulation does not support a finite-wavenumber Turing instability; the roll, square, and hexagonal modes are therefore presented only as generic pattern-theory modes rather than as patterns proved to arise from the present model. Numerical simulations illustrate spatiotemporal propagation and quantify the effects of vaccine efficacy, vaccination rate, and transmission intensity.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们针对 麻疹 的地理分布制定并分析了确定性反应扩散 SVEIR 模型,明确纳入了 疫苗接种、疫苗 功效、潜伏期、恢复、人口流动和空间扩散。使用下一代矩阵获得无病平衡和基本繁殖数$$\mathcal {R}_0$$,并通过线性稳定性分析确定入侵阈值和临界空间模式。由于临界波数为零,因此使用长波长分析来表征入侵前沿附近的缓慢空间变化。数学一致性检查表明,共扩散公式不支持有限波数图灵不稳定性;因此,滚动模式、方形模式和六边形模式仅作为通用模式理论模式提出,而不是作为被证明从当前模型产生的模式。数值模拟说明了时空传播并量化了 疫苗 功效、疫苗接种 速率和 传播 强度的影响。

The availability of the article in the Medline, PubMed and PMC databases as well as Web of Science will be obtained after the final publication according to the journal schedule Abstract BACKGROUND The global resurgence of measles has been accompanied by reports of breakthrough infection in previously immunized individuals, including healthcare personnel. Breakthrough measles can present with attenuated or atypical findings, but the clinical spectrum in fully vaccinated adults remains incompletely characterized. During outbreaks, documenting laboratory-confirmed cases in vaccinated healthcare workers is clinically relevant. CASE REPORT We describe a 30-year-old male pediatrician with a fully vaccinated history for measles, including 2 childhood doses and a measles-rubella booster in 2017, who developed measles after occupational exposure to an unvaccinated 6-year-old patient. Six days after exposure, he developed fever and a cephalocaudal maculopapular rash, followed by progressive systemic and respiratory symptoms, including cough, pharyngitis, and mild pain on breathing. On day 9, a room-air oxygen saturation of 92% prompted brief supplemental oxygen and short inpatient observation. Chest auscultation was normal, and thus chest radiography was not performed. Oxygenation improved rapidly with supportive care. Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab. He received supportive care, was hospitalized for 2 days, and recovered fully after 2 weeks of follow-up, with no documented complications or secondary cases among monitored contacts. CONCLUSIONS This case provides a descriptive, laboratory-confirmed example of breakthrough measles in a fully vaccinated healthcare worker during an active outbreak. Although these observations are consistent with partial or waning immunity, the exact mechanism of vaccine failure could not be established because pre-exposure measles serology and viral genotyping were not performed. Serological surveillance or targeted booster strategies for healthcare personnel should be regarded as context-dependent considerations requiring support from broader epidemiologic and serologic evidence. papers.title_original: A 30-Year-Old Male Pediatrician With Documented Complete Vaccination History and Laboratory-Confirmed Breakthrough Measles With Respiratory Involvement During a Measles Outbreak in Mexico

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to document a case of breakthrough measles in a fully vaccinated healthcare worker during an outbreak, highlighting the clinical relevance of such cases in vaccinated individuals. The global resurgence of measles has been accompanied by reports of breakthrough infections in previously immunized individuals, including healthcare personnel.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a case report describing a 30-year-old male pediatrician with a documented complete vaccination history who developed measles after occupational exposure to an unvaccinated 6-year-old patient during a measles outbreak in Mexico. The study was conducted during an active outbreak in Mexico.
analysis.methods: The case was evaluated through clinical observation and laboratory testing, including real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction to detect measles virus RNA in a pharyngeal swab. The patient received supportive care and was hospitalized for 2 days, with follow-up for 2 weeks.
analysis.main_results: Measles virus RNA was detected by real-time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction in a pharyngeal swab. The patient developed fever and a cephalocaudal maculopapular rash, followed by progressive systemic and respiratory symptoms, including cough, pharyngitis, and mild pain on breathing. Oxygenation improved rapidly with supportive care, and no complications or secondary cases were documented.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret this case as a descriptive, laboratory-confirmed example of breakthrough measles in a fully vaccinated healthcare worker during an active outbreak. The case contributes to understanding the clinical spectrum of measles in vaccinated adults.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case highlights the importance of documenting laboratory-confirmed breakthrough measles in vaccinated healthcare workers during outbreaks, which can inform surveillance and the potential need for targeted booster strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited by the absence of pre-exposure measles serology and viral genotyping, which prevents establishing the exact mechanism of vaccine failure. The study provides a descriptive example but lacks broader epidemiologic data, resulting in moderate confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old male pediatrician with a complete vaccination history who developed breakthrough measles during an outbreak in Mexico. The patient presented with fever, rash, and respiratory symptoms, and measles virus RNA was detected in a pharyngeal swab. He received supportive care, was hospitalized for 2 days, and fully recovered within 2 weeks without complications or secondary cases. The case underscores the clinical relevance of breakthrough infections in vaccinated healthcare workers and suggests the need for further epidemiologic and serologic studies. However, the absence of pre-exposure serology and viral genotyping limits the understanding of the exact mechanism of vaccine failure, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

papers.title: Declining Measles Vaccination Coverage and Measles Resurgence in the Americas: A Systematic Review of Associations with Incidence and Outbreaks
papers.abstract: This systematic review examines the association between insufficient or declining population-level measles vaccination coverage and measles incidence or outbreak occurrence in the Americas. The review focuses on observational epidemiological evidence, including ecological, longitudinal, and spatial analyses using observed vaccination coverage and measles outcomes. Searches were conducted in PubMed/MEDLINE, LILACS, and SciELO, covering publications from November 2, 2016, to November 2, 2026. The review includes evidence from national and subnational populations and considers statistically significant and non-significant associations. Bibliographic screening has been conducted, and the eligibility and quantitative findings of candidate studies are being verified. Final risk-of-bias assessment and evidence synthesis remain in progress.

papers.title: Not Immune After All: Polymerase Chain Reaction–Confirmed Measles in a Presumed-Immune 70-Year-Old Returning Traveler
papers.abstract: Measles is an increasingly important consideration in adults with febrile rash illness, particularly after international travel. We report a 70-year-old woman who developed measles following travel to Israel despite presumed immunity based on age and a reported history of childhood infection. She presented with fever, cough, and rash, followed by cephalocaudal progression of the rash, conjunctival injection, and oral lesions. Oropharyngeal polymerase chain reaction confirmed measles; serum IgG was negative. This case highlights limitations of presumed immunity and the importance of early diagnosis, isolation, and public health notification.

papers.title_zh: 终究没有免疫力:聚合酶链式反应——在一位假定免疫的 70 岁归国旅行者身上证实了 麻疹
papers.source_body_en: Measles is an increasingly important consideration in adults with febrile rash illness, particularly after international travel. We report a 70-year-old woman who developed measles following travel to Israel despite presumed immunity based on age and a reported history of childhood infection. She presented with fever, cough, and rash, followed by cephalocaudal progression of the rash, conjunctival injection, and oral lesions. Oropharyngeal polymerase chain reaction confirmed measles; serum IgG was negative. This case highlights limitations of presumed immunity and the importance of early diagnosis, isolation, and public health notification.

papers.title: Hemagglutinin and fusion proteins precede measles virus ribonucleoproteins and marshal cell-to-cell spread in airway epithelium
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Measles virus (MeV) is the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. To understand how it spreads in the airways, we infected well-differentiated primary cultures of human airway epithelial cells (HAE). We discovered that the MeV attachment protein (hemagglutinin, H), the fusion (F) protein, and the assembly organizer protein (matrix, M) reach newly infected cells ahead of, and independently from, the replicative complex proteins. To characterize the mechanisms of MeV spread, we generated a replication-deficient adenoviral vector expressing the MeV M, F, and H proteins in a doxycycline-inducible manner. This viral vector formed infectious centers that preserved epithelial function like those from MeV infection. To further dissect this process, we generated Ad vectors expressing individual MeV proteins, termed Ad-M, Ad-F, and Ad-H. Transduction of HAE with single, double, and triple Ad vector combinations revealed that Ad-F and Ad-H are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers. MeV enters and spreads within airway epithelia via H protein binding to adherens junction protein, nectin-4. To disrupt spread, we introduced the point mutation H Y543A , a mutation previously described to inhibit nectin-4 binding, in the Ad-H vector. Co-transduction of Ad-F and Ad-H Y543A did not result in MeV-like infectious center formation. Finally, we assessed whether the MeV-related paramyxovirus Nipah (NiV) attachment and fusion proteins (G and F, respectively) support cell-to-cell spread. Co-transduction of HAE with Ad-NiV-G and Ad-NiV-F did not result in infectious center formation, suggesting that decoupling of the membrane fusion apparatus function from replication is a unique feature of the MeV envelope glycoproteins. IMPORTANCE Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen. We characterized a mechanism by which measles virus spreads rapidly through the cells that line the human airway in an ex vivo model. We show that the proteins of the viral membrane fusion apparatus, hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F), move independently from and reach newly infected cells before the proteins of the replicative complex. Thus, viral protein spread is assembled and arranged in order (i.e., marshaled ). Using adenovirus-based vectors, we show that co-expression of H and F proteins promotes rapid sequential spread to multiple cells and the formation of infectious centers. Further elucidation of the mechanism of measles virus amplification and cell-to-cell spread within the lung may help explain its highly contagious nature.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism of measles virus (MeV) spread in human airway epithelial cells (HAE). The research question focuses on understanding how MeV spreads through the airways, which is critical given its status as the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. The study design involves infecting HAE with MeV and using replication-deficient adenoviral vectors to express MeV proteins. The main results show that the hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F) proteins are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers, while the replicative complex proteins arrive later. The authors interpret these findings as evidence of a sequential and ordered spread of viral proteins, which may explain the virus's high contagiousness. The study's significance lies in its potential to inform future research on MeV transmission and prevention. The evidence strength is moderate due to the ex vivo model and lack of in vivo data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 是最具传染性的人类呼吸道病原体。为了了解它如何在气道中传播,我们感染了分化良好的人气道上皮细胞(HAE)的原代培养物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们在离体模型中描述了 麻疹病毒 在人体气道内细胞中快速传播的机制。我们感染了人气道上皮细胞 (HAE) 的分化良好的原代培养物,以了解 MeV 如何在气道中传播。
elements_zh.methods: 为了表征 MeV 传播的机制,我们生成了复制缺陷型腺病毒 媒介,它以多西环素诱导的方式表达 MeV M、F 和 H 蛋白。我们还生成了表达单个 MeV 蛋白的 Ad 媒介,称为 Ad-M、Ad-F 和 Ad-H,以进一步剖析这一过程。
elements_zh.main_results: 用单、双和三 Ad 媒介 组合转导 HAE 表明,Ad-F 和 Ad-H 对于形成 MeV 样感染中心是必要且充分的。HAE 与 Ad-NiV-G 和 Ad-NiV-F 的共转导不会导致感染中心的形成。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们表明,病毒膜融合装置的蛋白质,血凝素(H)和融合蛋白(F),独立于复制复合物的蛋白质移动并先到达新感染的细胞。因此,病毒蛋白传播按顺序组装和排列(即编组)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 进一步阐明 麻疹病毒 肺部扩增和细胞间传播的机制可能有助于解释其高度传染性。这可能为未来关于 麻疹病毒 传播 和预防策略的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告局限性。该研究基于离体模型,不包括体内数据,这可能会限制普遍性。信心程度适中。

papers.title_zh: 血凝素和融合蛋白先于 麻疹病毒 核糖核蛋白并在气道上皮细胞中引导细胞间的扩散
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Measles virus (MeV) is the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. To understand how it spreads in the airways, we infected well-differentiated primary cultures of human airway epithelial cells (HAE). We discovered that the MeV attachment protein (hemagglutinin, H), the fusion (F) protein, and the assembly organizer protein (matrix, M) reach newly infected cells ahead of, and independently from, the replicative complex proteins. To characterize the mechanisms of MeV spread, we generated a replication-deficient adenoviral vector expressing the MeV M, F, and H proteins in a doxycycline-inducible manner. This viral vector formed infectious centers that preserved epithelial function like those from MeV infection. To further dissect this process, we generated Ad vectors expressing individual MeV proteins, termed Ad-M, Ad-F, and Ad-H. Transduction of HAE with single, double, and triple Ad vector combinations revealed that Ad-F and Ad-H are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers. MeV enters and spreads within airway epithelia via H protein binding to adherens junction protein, nectin-4. To disrupt spread, we introduced the point mutation H Y543A , a mutation previously described to inhibit nectin-4 binding, in the Ad-H vector. Co-transduction of Ad-F and Ad-H Y543A did not result in MeV-like infectious center formation. Finally, we assessed whether the MeV-related paramyxovirus Nipah (NiV) attachment and fusion proteins (G and F, respectively) support cell-to-cell spread. Co-transduction of HAE with Ad-NiV-G and Ad-NiV-F did not result in infectious center formation, suggesting that decoupling of the membrane fusion apparatus function from replication is a unique feature of the MeV envelope glycoproteins. IMPORTANCE Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen. We characterized a mechanism by which measles virus spreads rapidly through the cells that line the human airway in an ex vivo model. We show that the proteins of the viral membrane fusion apparatus, hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F), move independently from and reach newly infected cells before the proteins of the replicative complex. Thus, viral protein spread is assembled and arranged in order (i.e., marshaled ). Using adenovirus-based vectors, we show that co-expression of H and F proteins promotes rapid sequential spread to multiple cells and the formation of infectious centers. Further elucidation of the mechanism of measles virus amplification and cell-to-cell spread within the lung may help explain its highly contagious nature.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 是最具传染性的人类呼吸道病原体。为了了解它如何在气道中传播,我们感染了分化良好的人气道上皮细胞(HAE)的原代培养物。我们发现 MeV 附着蛋白(血凝素,H)、融合蛋白(F)和组装组织蛋白(基质,M)先于复制复合体蛋白到达新感染的细胞,并且独立于复制复合体蛋白。为了表征 MeV 传播的机制,我们生成了复制缺陷型腺病毒 媒介,它以多西环素诱导的方式表达 MeV M、F 和 H 蛋白。这种病毒 媒介 形成了感染中心,保留了与 MeV 感染类似的上皮功能。为了进一步剖析这个过程,我们生成了表达单个 MeV 蛋白的 Ad 媒介,称为 Ad-M、Ad-F 和 Ad-H。用单、双和三 Ad 媒介 组合转导 HAE 表明,Ad-F 和 Ad-H 对于形成 MeV 样感染中心是必要且充分的。MeV 通过 H 蛋白与粘附连接蛋白 nectin-4 结合进入气道上皮并在气道上皮内传播。为了破坏传播,我们在 Ad-H 媒介 中引入了点 突变 H Y543A,这是先前描述的抑制 nectin-4 结合的 突变。Ad-F和Ad-H Y543A的共转导没有导致MeV样感染中心的形成。最后,我们评估了 MeV 相关副粘病毒尼帕 (NiV) 附着蛋白和融合蛋白(分别为 G 和 F)是否支持细胞间传播。HAE 与 Ad-NiV-G 和 Ad-NiV-F 的共转导不会导致感染中心的形成,这表明膜融合装置功能与复制的解偶联是 MeV 包膜糖蛋白的独特特征。重要性 麻疹病毒 是一种高度传染性的病原体。我们在离体模型中描述了 麻疹病毒 在人体气道内细胞中快速传播的机制。我们表明,病毒膜融合装置的蛋白质,血凝素(H)和融合蛋白(F),独立于复制复合物的蛋白质移动并先到达新感染的细胞。因此,病毒蛋白传播按顺序组装和排列(即编组)。使用基于腺病毒的 媒介,我们发现 H 和 F 蛋白的共表达促进快速顺序传播到多个细胞和感染中心的形成。进一步阐明 麻疹病毒 肺部扩增和细胞间传播的机制可能有助于解释其高度传染性。

papers.title: Nectin-4 mediates rubella virus entry in airway and placental cells
papers.abstract: Abstract Rubella virus (RuV) causes rubella and, when acquired during pregnancy, congenital rubella syndrome (CRS). Despite its clinical significance, the cellular entry mechanism of RuV remains poorly characterized owing to limited knowledge of host receptors, hampering pathogenesis studies and therapeutic development. Here, we identify Nectin-4 as a functional RuV entry receptor through proximity biotin labeling-based proteomics coupled with CRISPR/Cas9 validation. Notably, Nectin-4 is shared with measles virus, revealing convergent evolution in viral entry despite the different viral families. Nectin-4 directly interacts with the RuV envelope glycoproteins through its ectodomain, facilitating receptor-mediated endocytosis following initial calcium-dependent viral attachment. In polarized respiratory epithelial cells, Nectin-4 mediates basolateral viral entry and subsequent apical release of progeny virions, enabling efficient respiratory transmission. Using human placental organoid models, we demonstrate that syncytiotrophoblasts serve as primary targets for transplacental RuV infection, with viral entry significantly inhibited by Nectin-4 blockade. These findings establish Nectin-4 as critical for both horizontal respiratory transmission and vertical maternal–fetal transmission of RuV. Our results provide fundamental insights into RuV pathogenesis and identify Nectin-4 as a promising therapeutic target for CRS. Importantly, the discovery of shared receptor utilization between RuV and measles virus opens new avenues for integrated elimination strategies targeting both pathogens.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the ongoing measles crisis in Bangladesh, highlighting the need to understand the disease's impact and the challenges in its prevention.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is an editorial analyzing the measles situation in Bangladesh, focusing on the disease's prevalence and the factors contributing to its persistence in the region.
analysis.methods: The editorial reviews existing literature and reports on measles outbreaks, vaccine coverage, and public health responses in Bangladesh without detailing specific methodologies or data collection procedures.
analysis.main_results: The editorial notes that measles remains a preventable crisis in Bangladesh due to low vaccination rates and gaps in disease surveillance.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as a call to action for improving measles control strategies in Bangladesh, emphasizing the need for better surveillance and vaccination programs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the importance of strengthening measles surveillance and immunization efforts in Bangladesh to prevent outbreaks and reduce disease burden.

The analysis is based on an abstract-only review, which limits the depth of findings and the strength of conclusions. The study serves as a reminder of the importance of targeted public health interventions to address the preventable nature of measles in Bangladesh.

papers.full_text: Pennsylvania is experiencing its worst measles outbreak in more than three decades, with more than 1,400 confirmed cases and six measles-associated deaths so far in 2026, according to statistics compiled by the state. Each new case brings a new warning of a measles exposure in that community. Exposures have occurred at hospitals and doctors’ offices, grocery stores and restaurants, and K-12 schools and universities. Exposure alerts come with the same instructions: Check your MMR vaccine status, and watch for symptoms for the next three weeks. People are told that two doses of the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine are 97% effective at preventing measles. The underlying message is that if you’re vaccinated, you’re protected. The MMR vaccine is highly effective at preventing disease, but it isn’t a guarantee. People may hear that 97% figure and wonder about the other 3%. Parents ask me: Should I be worried? How do I know if my kid has measles? Do I need an MMR booster? Most recently, my teenage daughter texted me to ask about her MMR vaccine status. She was worried about what would happen if she were exposed. These are questions I can answer as both a mother and an epidemiologist in northwestern Pennsylvania. I became both at once. My daughter was born at the start of my doctoral program, and I read epidemiology textbooks aloud to her while studying for my comprehensive exams. I defended my dissertation on my son’s due date. I’m a better mother because I’m an epidemiologist, and a better epidemiologist because I’m a mom. Are these measles exposure alerts cause for alarm? The advice in each public measles exposure alert matches the guidance doctors follow when a patient may have been exposed. Everyone is asked to watch for symptoms, whether or not they’re vaccinated. The number of unvaccinated people across Pennsylvania is growing. As a result, many communities, including Allegheny County, no longer have herd immunity. Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were people who had been vaccinated. These cases are known as breakthrough infections. The term “herd immunity” wasn’t coined until 1918. That year, a veterinarian wrote about an outbreak of “contagious abortion” in sheep and cattle, a literal herd. Today, herd immunity means that the risk of disease for susceptible people, those without immunity, drops when they are surrounded by people who are immune. In other words, if the people around you are immune, you’re unlikely to get sick even if you’re susceptible. For measles, that protection depends on about 95% of people being immune. In a school or community where fewer than 95% of people are vaccinated, measles can spread more easily. In Allegheny County, 93.8% of children are fully vaccinated against measles. Some neighborhoods are above 97% uptake, while others are below the necessary 95% needed for herd immunity. What happens after an exposure? Measles exposures are announced publicly by the Department of Health and local healthcare providers. During a measles outbreak, public health departments may get in touch with close contacts to alert them to an exposure. Public exposure alerts, like the one made in October after there was a measles exposure at a Target near Pittsburgh, are also used. Public alerts are for settings where exposed people can’t be identified and contacted individually. Measles is so contagious that a single case can infect up to 18 susceptible people. Measles spreads through the air and through respiratory droplets, like those released when someone sneezes. The virus can also survive outside the body, lingering in the air and on surfaces. Imagine I have measles and walk into my local grocery store. I’m contagious from about four days before the rash appears until four days after. Every time I breathe out, I release virus particles into the air, and those particles can stay infectious for up to two hours. If I sneeze in the produce section, the virus can survive on surfaces for up to two hours. However, if you’ve had measles or were vaccinated with two doses of the MMR vaccine, you are protected. Two doses provides 97% lifetime protection against measles. This means that even without herd immunity, fewer than 3% of individuals with immunity are likely to contract measles. Adults who have had measles, or who have documentation of the recommended doses of the MMR vaccine, don’t need a booster. People who were vaccinated between 1963 and 1967, or who aren’t sure which vaccine they received, should talk to their primary care provider about whether they need another dose. This is because the measles vaccine used between those years was not as effective as the MMR vaccine that is currently given. Today, children typically get their first dose of the MMR vaccine at 12 to 15 months old and a second dose at 4 to 6 years old. papers.title_original: What the measles vaccine’s ‘97% effective’ rating means for Pittsburgh parents

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the public health concern of measles outbreaks in Pennsylvania and the effectiveness of the MMR vaccine in preventing measles, particularly in light of the 97% effectiveness rating and its implications for communities with low vaccination rates.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is based on public health statistics and epidemiological observations from Pennsylvania, focusing on measles cases and vaccination rates among children and adults in Allegheny County and other affected areas.
analysis.methods: The study relies on public health records, exposure alerts, and epidemiological data to assess vaccination rates and measles transmission dynamics, without conducting new experiments or detailed statistical analyses.
analysis.main_results: Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were among vaccinated individuals, and 93.8% of children in Allegheny County are fully vaccinated against measles, with some neighborhoods below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the 97% effectiveness of the MMR vaccine as providing strong protection, but not absolute immunity, and highlight the importance of maintaining high vaccination rates to prevent outbreaks, noting that even vaccinated individuals can contract measles in rare cases.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform public health strategies for measles prevention, emphasizing the need for maintaining high vaccination coverage to achieve herd immunity and reduce the risk of outbreaks, particularly in communities with lower uptake.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is based on public health statistics and does not include detailed experimental data or randomized trials, which limits the strength of the conclusions to a moderate level.

analysis.summary_en: This article discusses the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania in 2026, highlighting the 97% effectiveness of the MMR vaccine and the importance of herd immunity. It explains that while the vaccine is highly effective, it is not foolproof, and communities with vaccination rates below 95% are at risk. The piece also notes that some vaccinated individuals can still contract measles, and that public health alerts are used to inform people of exposures. The author, an epidemiologist, shares personal and professional insights into the implications of these findings for parents and public health officials.
