Arts + Culture Economy Education Environment + Energy Ethics + Religion Health Politics + Society Science + Tech World Podcasts Local Demand for the MMR vaccine has risen in Pennsylvania as the state’s measles outbreak has grown. Joe Raedle via Getty Images News What the measles vaccine’s ‘97% effective’ rating means for Pittsburgh parents Published: November 6, 2026 8:13am EST Pennsylvania is experiencing its worst measles outbreak in more than three decades, with more than 1,400 confirmed cases and six measles-associated deaths so far in 2026, according to statistics compiled by the state. Each new case brings a new warning of a measles exposure in that community. Exposures have occurred at hospitals and doctors’ offices, grocery stores and restaurants, and K-12 schools and universities. Exposure alerts come with the same instructions: Check your MMR vaccine status, and watch for symptoms for the next three weeks. People are told that two doses of the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine are 97% effective at preventing measles. The underlying message is that if you’re vaccinated, you’re protected. The MMR vaccine is highly effective at preventing disease, but it isn’t a guarantee. People may hear that 97% figure and wonder about the other 3%. Parents ask me: Should I be worried? How do I know if my kid has measles? Do I need an MMR booster? Most recently, my teenage daughter texted me to ask about her MMR vaccine status. She was worried about what would happen if she were exposed. These are questions I can answer as both a mother and an epidemiologist in northwestern Pennsylvania. I became both at once. My daughter was born at the start of my doctoral program, and I read epidemiology textbooks aloud to her while studying for my comprehensive exams. I defended my dissertation on my son’s due date. I’m a better mother because I’m an epidemiologist, and a better epidemiologist because I’m a mom. Are these measles exposure alerts cause for alarm? The advice in each public measles exposure alert matches the guidance doctors follow when a patient may have been exposed. Everyone is asked to watch for symptoms, whether or not they’re vaccinated. The number of unvaccinated people across Pennsylvania is growing. As a result, many communities, including Allegheny County, no longer have herd immunity. Four of the over 1,400 confirmed measles cases in Pennsylvania were people who had been vaccinated. These cases are known as breakthrough infections. Pop-up clinics in Pennsylvania have offered MMR vaccines as the state’s measles outbreak grows. Sean Rayford/Stringer via Getty Images News The term “herd immunity” wasn’t coined until 1918. That year, a veterinarian wrote about an outbreak of “contagious abortion” in sheep and cattle, a literal herd. Today, herd immunity means that the risk of disease for susceptible people, those without immunity, drops when they are surrounded by people who are immune. In other words, if the people around you are immune, you’re unlikely to get sick even if you’re susceptible. For measles, that protection depends on about 95% of people being immune. In a school or community where fewer than 95% of people are vaccinated, measles can spread more easily. In Allegheny County, 93.8% of children are fully vaccinated against measles. Some neighborhoods are above 97% uptake, while others are below the necessary 95% needed for herd immunity. What happens after an exposure? Measles exposures are announced publicly by the Department of Health and local healthcare providers. During a measles outbreak, public health departments may get in touch with close contacts to alert them to an exposure. Public exposure alerts, like the one made in October after there was a measles exposure at a Target near Pittsburgh, are also used. Public alerts are for settings where exposed people can’t be identified and contacted individually. Measles is so contagious that a single case can infect up to 18 susceptible people. Measles spreads through the air and through respiratory droplets, like those released when someone sneezes. The virus can also survive outside the body, lingering in the air and on surfaces. Imagine I have measles and walk into my local grocery store. I’m contagious from about four days before the rash appears until four days after. Every time I breathe out, I release virus particles into the air, and those particles can stay infectious for up to two hours. If I sneeze in the produce section, the virus can survive on surfaces for up to two hours. However, if you’ve had measles or were vaccinated with two doses of the MMR vaccine, you are protected. Two doses provides 97% lifetime protection against measles. This means that even without herd immunity, fewer than 3% of individuals with immunity are likely to contract measles. Adults who have had measles, or who have documentation of the recommended doses of the MMR vaccine, don’t need a booster. People who were vaccinated between 1963 and 1967, or who aren’t sure which vaccine they received, should talk to their primary care provider about whether they need another dose. This is because the measles vaccine used between those years was not as effective as the MMR vaccine that is currently given. Today, children typically get their first dose of the MMR vaccine at 12 to 15 months old and a second dose at 4 to 6 years old. Because the vaccine is given in early childhood, people born in the early to mid-1960s are the most likely to have received the older vaccine. People born before 1957 are generally considered immune, because measles was so widespread then that almost everyone caught it as a child. What are the symptoms of measles? Symptoms of measles include a high fever that can reach 105 degrees Fahrenheit (40.6 degrees Celsius), a cough, a runny nose and conjunctivitis, also known as pin keye. These symptoms overlap with those of other respiratory viruses, such as flu and COVID-19. Most people with measles develop a red, blotchy rash. It starts on the face and spreads down the body, like paint poured from a bucket. People who are immunocompromised or were previously vaccinated, even with one dose of the MMR vaccine, may not develop the rash. Between 25% and 40% of immunocompromised people with measles never get the rash. A telltale sign of measles is Koplik spots, tiny white spots inside the mouth that can show up a day or two before the rash. Why does measles keep making headlines? Measles can have serious consequences. About 1 in 20 people with measles develop pneumonia, and up to 3 in 1,000 cases end in death. Children younger than 5 and adults older than 20 are most likely to experience these severe complications. Without herd immunity in many communities, measles cases, hospitalizations and deaths in Pennsylvania are likely to keep rising. The state Department of Health reports community spread of measles in 14 of Pennsylvania’s 67 counties. Each of these cases is mostly preventable with the MMR vaccine. The U.S. declared measles eliminated in 2000, meaning it was no longer spreading continuously here. This year’s outbreak shows how quickly that can change and the negative health consequences it can have in our communities. Read more of our stories about Pittsburgh and Pennsylvania. papers.title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
papers.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

papers.title_zh: 多发性硬化症和病毒:《危险关系》。
papers.source_body_en: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.
papers.abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分不明。与MS发病相关的风险因素包括遗传易感性和多种环境应激因素;然而,最近病毒感染引起了广泛关注,被认为是重要的环境诱因。尽管已知EB病毒(EBV)与MS易感性之间存在明确的关联,但单一病原体模型无法清晰描述驱动该疾病分子级联反应的机制,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变可能涉及不止一种病毒。在本综述中,我们探讨了不同神经嗜性病毒之间的相互作用可能在MS中发挥协同致病作用的假设,这一领域目前在文献中研究较少。我们总结了不同病毒在MS发病中作用的矛盾证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2,以及水痘-带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2以及人类内源性逆转录病毒(HERVs)。这些病毒可能通过在共享分子通路中的相互作用、免疫调节以及激活潜伏感染,共同影响MS中特征性的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述评估了病毒相互作用在MS病因中的作用,通过这些病原体的累积和交互效应。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据表明,病毒的共同暴露可能在遗传易感个体中协同影响MS的易感性。明确这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过靶向控制病毒网络开发预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

papers.title: Epidemiological Characteristics and Clinical Outcomes of Vaccine-associated Urticaria: A Retrospective Cross-sectional Analysis of the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System Database (1990-2025).
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Urticaria is a commonly reported cutaneous adverse event following vaccination, which may range from mild self-limiting reactions to more severe hypersensitivity manifestations. Monitoring vaccine-associated urticaria is important for ongoing vaccine safety surveillance and pharmacovigilance. However, large-scale population-based analyses evaluating demographic characteristics, vaccine associations, onset intervals, and severity patterns remain limited. AIM: The aim of the study was to analyze reports of urticaria in the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) database between 1990 and 2025 and evaluate demographic characteristics, vaccine type distribution, onset intervals, temporal trends, and seriousness patterns. METHODOLOGY: A retrospective observational study was conducted using data from the VAERS database. Reports of urticaria submitted between January 1990 and March 2025 were included. The variables analyzed included age, sex, vaccine type, onset interval, and seriousness classification. Descriptive statistics were generated using frequencies and percentages, and comparative analyses were performed between serious and nonserious reports. RESULTS: A total of 61,996 urticaria reports were identified during the study period. Most reports occurred among adults aged 18-49 years and females. Most reports were classified as nonserious and occurred within the early postvaccination period. COVID-19 vaccines accounted for the highest proportion of reports, followed by influenza and measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines. Temporal analysis demonstrated a marked increase in reporting during 2021, followed by declining trends thereafter. Comparative analysis identified differences in demographic and clinical characteristics between serious and nonserious reports. CONCLUSION: Urticaria is a frequently reported adverse event following vaccination, with identifiable demographic, temporal, and clinical patterns. Most reports were nonserious and occurred shortly after vaccination, although differences were observed between serious and nonserious reports. Continued pharmacovigilance and future studies incorporating detailed clinical data are needed to better understand factors associated with vaccine-related urticaria.

papers.title_zh: 疫苗 相关荨麻疹的流行病学特征和临床结果:疫苗 不良事件报告系统数据库(1990-2025)的回顾性横断面分析。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Urticaria is a commonly reported cutaneous adverse event following vaccination, which may range from mild self-limiting reactions to more severe hypersensitivity manifestations. Monitoring vaccine-associated urticaria is important for ongoing vaccine safety surveillance and pharmacovigilance. However, large-scale population-based analyses evaluating demographic characteristics, vaccine associations, onset intervals, and severity patterns remain limited. AIM: The aim of the study was to analyze reports of urticaria in the Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) database between 1990 and 2025 and evaluate demographic characteristics, vaccine type distribution, onset intervals, temporal trends, and seriousness patterns. METHODOLOGY: A retrospective observational study was conducted using data from the VAERS database. Reports of urticaria submitted between January 1990 and March 2025 were included. The variables analyzed included age, sex, vaccine type, onset interval, and seriousness classification. Descriptive statistics were generated using frequencies and percentages, and comparative analyses were performed between serious and nonserious reports. RESULTS: A total of 61,996 urticaria reports were identified during the study period. Most reports occurred among adults aged 18-49 years and females. Most reports were classified as nonserious and occurred within the early postvaccination period. COVID-19 vaccines accounted for the highest proportion of reports, followed by influenza and measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines. Temporal analysis demonstrated a marked increase in reporting during 2021, followed by declining trends thereafter. Comparative analysis identified differences in demographic and clinical characteristics between serious and nonserious reports. CONCLUSION: Urticaria is a frequently reported adverse event following vaccination, with identifiable demographic, temporal, and clinical patterns. Most reports were nonserious and occurred shortly after vaccination, although differences were observed between serious and nonserious reports. Continued pharmacovigilance and future studies incorporating detailed clinical data are needed to better understand factors associated with vaccine-related urticaria.

papers.title: Childhood vaccination at a crossroads: rebuilding confidence, overcoming inequities, and translating scientific advances into global health gains.
papers.abstract: The resurgence of measles is a warning that decades of progress in childhood immunisation cannot be taken for granted. A Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023 analysis covering 204 countries and territories estimates 15.6 million measles cases and 118,000 deaths among children younger than five years in 2023. Following a decline of approximately 79% in estimated cases between 1990 and 2019, cases increased by 40% between 2019 and 2023. First-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage was estimated at 81.0% and second-dose (MCV2) coverage at 71.4% in 2023 [1] These are modelled estimates with substantial uncertainty, not surveillance case counts.

papers.title: Childhood vaccination in Mali: Determinants and differences between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions from the 2023-2024 Demographic and Health Survey.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Armed conflict may disrupt immunization services and increase barriers to childhood vaccination. This study examined determinants of full basic childhood vaccination in Mali and assessed whether they differed between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. METHODS: We conducted a secondary analysis of the 2023-2024 Mali Demographic and Health Survey, including 2859 children aged 12-23 months. Full basic vaccination was defined as receipt of Bacille Calmette-Guérin vaccine, three doses of pentavalent vaccine, three doses of oral polio vaccine (excluding the birth dose), and measles vaccine. Survey-weighted logistic regression models were fitted nationally and separately for conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. Interactions between conflict status and selected explanatory variables were tested. RESULTS: Full basic vaccination coverage was 51.87%. Coverage did not differ significantly between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions (50.08% vs 52.64%; p = 0.467), and conflict status was not independently associated with vaccination after adjustment. Antenatal care attendance and facility-based delivery were consistently associated with higher odds of full vaccination. In conflict-affected regions, media exposure and shorter perceived distance to health facilities were also associated with higher vaccination uptake. A significant interaction was observed between conflict status and distance to health facility (p = 0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Childhood vaccination coverage in Mali remains suboptimal. Although overall coverage was similar across conflict and non-conflict regions, determinants differed by context, highlighting the need for tailored strategies to improve vaccine uptake.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the determinants of full basic childhood vaccination in Mali, focusing on differences between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. The research aimed to understand how factors like antenatal care attendance, facility-based delivery, media exposure, and perceived distance to health facilities influence vaccination rates. The study used data from the 2023-2024 Demographic and Health Survey, analyzing 2859 children aged 12-23 months. Results showed that overall vaccination coverage was 51.87%, with no significant difference between conflict-affected and non-conflict regions. However, a significant interaction was found between conflict status and distance to health facilities. The authors concluded that while vaccination coverage is suboptimal, determinants vary by context, emphasizing the need for tailored strategies. The study's findings suggest that improving access to health facilities and promoting antenatal care and facility-based delivery could enhance vaccination rates, particularly in conflict-affected areas. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of detailed limitations reported.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 武装冲突可能会扰乱免疫服务并增加儿童的障碍 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了马里完整基础童年 疫苗接种 的决定因素,并评估了这些决定因素在受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区之间是否存在差异。
elements_zh.methods: 我们对 2023-2024 年马里人口和健康调查进行了二次分析,其中包括 2859 名 12-23 个月大的儿童。调查加权逻辑回归模型在全国范围内分别针对受冲突影响和非冲突地区进行拟合。测试了冲突状态和选定的解释变量之间的相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 疫苗接种 的基本基本覆盖率为 51.87%。受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区的覆盖范围没有显着差异(50.08% vs 52.64%;p = 0.467),调整后冲突状态与 疫苗接种 不独立相关。观察到冲突状态和距医疗机构的距离之间存在显着的交互作用 (p = 0.01)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管冲突地区和非冲突地区的总体覆盖范围相似,但决定因素因背景而异,凸显需要制定量身定制的策略来提高 疫苗 的采用率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 马里的童年 疫苗接种 覆盖率仍然不理想。产前护理就诊率和设施分娩始终与较高的完全 疫苗接种 几率相关。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告该研究的具体局限性。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:武装冲突可能会扰乱免疫服务并增加儿童 疫苗接种 的障碍。本研究调查了马里完整基础童年 疫苗接种 的决定因素,并评估了这些决定因素在受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区之间是否存在差异。方法:我们对 2023-2024 年马里人口和健康调查进行了二次分析,其中包括 2859 名 12-23 个月大的儿童。完全基本疫苗接种被定义为接受卡介苗疫苗、三剂五价疫苗、三剂口服脊髓灰质炎疫苗(不包括出生剂量)和麻疹 疫苗。调查加权逻辑回归模型在全国范围内分别针对受冲突影响和非冲突地区进行拟合。测试了冲突状态和选定的解释变量之间的相互作用。结果:疫苗接种 的基本基本覆盖率为 51.87%。受冲突影响地区和非冲突地区的覆盖范围没有显着差异(50.08% vs 52.64%;p = 0.467),调整后冲突状态与 疫苗接种 不独立相关。产前护理就诊率和设施分娩始终与较高的完全 疫苗接种 几率相关。在受冲突影响的地区,媒体曝光和距医疗机构的感知距离较短也与 疫苗接种 的使用率较高有关。观察到冲突状态和距医疗机构的距离之间存在显着的交互作用 (p = 0.01)。结论:马里的儿童 疫苗接种 覆盖率仍然不理想。尽管冲突地区和非冲突地区的总体覆盖范围相似,但决定因素因背景而异,凸显需要制定量身定制的策略来提高 疫苗 的采用率。

papers.title: 990 Infectious complications following blinatumomab immunotherapy in paediatric B-ALL- A real-world analysis from a large tertiary cancer care centre in India
papers.abstract: Background Blinatumomab’s mechanism of action induces T-cell activation and hypogammaglobulinemia which can predispose patients to infections. In LMICs, distinct environmental pathogen exposures, resource constraints, and baseline nutritional variations may amplify these risks. Real-world data regarding the infectious profile of blinatumomab in LMICs remains scarce. We aim to characterize the incidence, microbiological-spectrum, and clinical impact of infectious-complications during blinatumomab-therapy in a resource-constrained setting.Methods We conducted a retrospective cohort study of pediatric patients with relapsed/refractory B-ALL who received blinatumomab between May 2021 and March 2026 at TMH, Mumbai. Infectious episodes were captured from the initiation of blinatumomab until 60 days post-therapy and graded using CTCAE v 5.0. Clinical correlations with concomitant Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), Post therapy IgG Levels, and survival outcomes were analyzed.Results There were 105 patients eligible for analysis, of which 55 (52.4%) developed a febrile episode within 60 days of initiating treatment. Almost all of these (54/55) had infections and presented with systemic features in 46 (85%), and local manifestations in 8 (15%). In the latter group, half (4/8) were due to Central-line site related infection. Amongst 42 episodes of systemic infections, the most common sites were respiratory tract (n = 6,38.1%) and the bloodstream(n = 15,35.7%).There was one case of colitis-associated viraemia, one with acute suppurative otitis media (2.4%),while the primary anatomic site remained unspecified in the remaining 10 cases (23.8%). Viral etiologies were highly predominant in this subset, accounting for 50% (n = 21) of the episodes, with Measles being the most frequently isolated pathogen ( figure 1). All deaths were driven by viral pathogens, with vaccine-preventable diseases like Measles being the primary cause of death in 80% of cases (n = 4/5),due to Measles Encephalitis, and one death being due to Parainfluenzae-induced pneumonia.Conclusions Infections are common in pediatric B-ALL patients treated with blinatumomab and may occur in more than half the patients. Systemic viral pathogens predominate over bacterial in frequency and are almost exclusively responsible for mortality. Clinical severity of concomitant CRS (≥ Grade 2) and lower IgG levels correlate with infectious vulnerability. All mortality observed was in vaccine-preventable diseases. While falling community vaccination rates may be responsible for localized outbreaks, targeted interventions including influenza vaccinations may help mitigate mortality.Abstract 990 Figure 1Systemic pathogen and infection related mortality. Association of CRS with infectionAbstract 990 Figure 2Association of CRS severity with 60-day infection incidence

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: Blinatumomab 的作用机制会诱导 T 细胞活化和低丙种球蛋白血症,从而使患者容易感染。在中低收入国家,不同的环境病原体暴露、资源限制和基线营养变化可能会放大这些风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们对 2021 年 5 月至 2026 年 3 月期间在孟买 TMH 接受 blinatumomab 治疗的复发/难治性 B-ALL 儿科患者进行了一项回顾性 队列研究 研究。有关 blinatumomab 在中低收入国家中感染情况的真实数据仍然很少。
elements_zh.methods: 我们的目标是描述在资源有限的环境中博纳吐单抗治疗期间感染并发症的 发病率、微生物谱和临床影响。记录从开始使用 blinatumomab 到治疗后 60 天的感染发作情况,并使用 CTCAE v 5.0 进行分级。
elements_zh.main_results: 有 105 名患者符合分析条件,其中 55 名患者(52.4%)在开始 治疗 后 60 天内出现发热发作。几乎所有这些患者 (54/55) 均出现感染,并有 46 例 (85%) 出现全身症状,8 例 (15%) 出现局部症状。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在接受 blinatumomab 治疗的儿童 B-ALL 患者中,感染发作非常普遍,病毒病因占感染发作的 50% (n = 21)。伴随的 CRS 的临床严重程度(≥ 2 级)和较低的 IgG 水平与感染易感性相关。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 系统性病毒病原体的频率高于细菌病原体,并且几乎完全是 死亡率 的原因。包括流感 死亡率 在内的有针对性的干预措施可能有助于减轻 死亡率 的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告研究设计的具体局限性或证据的强度。然而,该研究基于来自单个三级癌症护理中心的真实数据,这可能会限制普遍性。

papers.title: Ultrasensitive detection of neuronal DNA using genome-wide non-CG methylation patterns
papers.abstract: Summary Methylation-based liquid biopsies can identify the tissue origins of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA). A major constraint on the sensitivity of these assays is the limited number of cell-type-specific CpG markers. Here we exploit the high abundance of non-CpG (CpH) methylation in neurons to enable ultrasensitive detection of neuronal DNA. We show that neurons carry 100-fold higher CpH methylation than other tissues, in which apparent CpH methylation largely reflects experimental artifacts. Using a computational criterion to identify cfDNA molecules carrying clusters of methylated CpA sites, we detect neuronal DNA at proportions as low as 20 parts per million. Analysis of 231 samples from 163 individuals revealed minimal neuronal cfDNA in the plasma of healthy subjects; elevated levels in patients with measles or acute neurological conditions; strikingly high levels in brain-dead donors, indicating extensive ongoing neuronal death; and the highest levels in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients in a neurological intensive care unit. These findings establish genome-wide, fragment-level analysis of non-CpG methylation as an ultrasensitive approach for blood-based monitoring of brain injury and disease.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of current methylation-based liquid biopsies in identifying the tissue origins of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA), particularly in the context of detecting neuronal DNA. The background highlights that a major constraint on the sensitivity of these assays is the limited number of cell-type-specific CpG markers.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed 231 samples from 163 individuals, including healthy subjects, patients with measles, patients with acute neurological conditions, brain-dead donors, and patients in a neurological intensive care unit. The focus was on measuring neuronal cfDNA levels across these diverse populations.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a computational criterion to identify cfDNA molecules carrying clusters of methylated CpA sites, enabling the detection of neuronal DNA at proportions as low as 20 parts per million. This method was applied to analyze the samples.
analysis.main_results: Analysis revealed minimal neuronal cfDNA in the plasma of healthy subjects, elevated levels in patients with measles or acute neurological conditions, strikingly high levels in brain-dead donors, and the highest levels in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients in a neurological intensive care unit.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that genome-wide, fragment-level analysis of non-CpG methylation can serve as an ultrasensitive approach for blood-based monitoring of brain injury and disease, offering a novel method for detecting neuronal DNA.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results have significant implications for the development of more sensitive diagnostic tools for neurological conditions and brain injuries, potentially improving early detection and monitoring in clinical settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on a computational criterion and the absence of direct viral detection methods. However, the evidence is strong, as it is based on a well-defined set of samples and clear, quantifiable results.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the use of non-CpG methylation patterns in neuronal DNA to enhance the sensitivity of methylation-based liquid biopsies. The research addresses the challenge of identifying tissue origins of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA) by leveraging the high abundance of non-CpG methylation in neurons. By analyzing 231 samples from 163 individuals, including healthy subjects, measles patients, brain-dead donors, and neurological ICU patients, the study demonstrates that neuronal cfDNA can be detected at very low proportions. The results show minimal neuronal cfDNA in healthy individuals, elevated levels in measles and acute neurological conditions, and the highest levels in brain-dead donors and neurological ICU patients. The findings establish a novel method for ultrasensitive detection of neuronal DNA, which could improve the monitoring of brain injury and disease. The study's strength lies in its clear, quantifiable results, though it relies on computational methods without direct viral detection.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了来自 163 名个体的 231 个样本,包括健康受试者、麻疹 患者、患有急性神经系统疾病的患者、脑死亡捐献者以及神经重症监护病房的患者。重点是测量这些不同人群的神经元 cfDNA 水平。

papers.title_zh: 使用 基因组 全非 CG 甲基化模式对神经元 DNA 进行超灵敏检测
papers.source_body_en: Summary Methylation-based liquid biopsies can identify the tissue origins of circulating cell-free DNA (cfDNA). A major constraint on the sensitivity of these assays is the limited number of cell-type-specific CpG markers. Here we exploit the high abundance of non-CpG (CpH) methylation in neurons to enable ultrasensitive detection of neuronal DNA. We show that neurons carry 100-fold higher CpH methylation than other tissues, in which apparent CpH methylation largely reflects experimental artifacts. Using a computational criterion to identify cfDNA molecules carrying clusters of methylated CpA sites, we detect neuronal DNA at proportions as low as 20 parts per million. Analysis of 231 samples from 163 individuals revealed minimal neuronal cfDNA in the plasma of healthy subjects; elevated levels in patients with measles or acute neurological conditions; strikingly high levels in brain-dead donors, indicating extensive ongoing neuronal death; and the highest levels in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients in a neurological intensive care unit. These findings establish genome-wide, fragment-level analysis of non-CpG methylation as an ultrasensitive approach for blood-based monitoring of brain injury and disease.

papers.title: Neurological Complications of Mumps
papers.abstract: Abstract Mumps is a vaccinepreventable viral illness that primarily affects the parotid glands but can also lead to neurological complications. During a community mumps outbreak in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India, between February and April 2025, we encountered several pediatric patients with significant central nervous system (CNS) involvement. We describe two children who presented with acute cerebellitis, meningoencephalitis with hydrocephalus, and aseptic meningitis in the setting of recent mumps infection. Detailed clinical features and shortterm outcomes are presented. All children improved with appropriate antimicrobial and antiviral therapy, immunomodulation in selected cases, and neurosurgical intervention when indicated. Our series demonstrates that severe mumpsrelated CNS disease continues to occur in partially immunized pediatric populations and can be associated with substantial morbidity. These observations highlight the importance of maintaining high measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine coverage, ensuring early recognition and comprehensive management of neurological complications, and strengthening surveillance for mumps outbreaks in India.
papers.journal: Annals of Indian Academy of Neurology

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 腮腺炎是一种可通过疫苗预防的病毒性疾病,主要影响腮腺,但也可能导致神经系统并发症。2025 年 2 月至 4 月,在印度安得拉邦维沙卡帕特南的社区腮腺炎 暴发 期间,我们遇到了几名中枢神经系统 (CNS) 严重受累的儿科患者。我们描述了两名因近期感染腮腺炎而出现急性小脑炎、脑膜脑炎伴脑积水和无菌性脑膜炎的儿童。提出了详细的临床特征和短期结果。所有儿童均通过适当的抗菌药物和 抗病毒药物 治疗、特定病例的免疫调节以及有指征时的神经外科干预而得到改善。我们的系列研究表明,严重的腮腺炎相关中枢神经系统疾病继续发生在部分免疫的儿科人群中,并且可能与大量发病率相关。这些观察结果强调了保持 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹 (MMR) 疫苗 高覆盖率、确保神经系统并发症的早期识别和综合管理以及加强 监测 在印度腮腺炎 暴发 治疗的重要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 这项研究旨在解决与腮腺炎相关的神经系统并发症的风险和影响,腮腺炎是一种 疫苗 可预防的病毒性疾病,主要影响腮腺,但也可能导致严重的中枢神经系统受累。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2025 年 2 月至 4 月在印度安得拉邦维沙卡帕特南的社区腮腺炎 暴发 期间进行,重点关注腮腺炎感染后表现出严重中枢神经系统受累的儿科患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究描述了两名因近期感染腮腺炎而出现急性小脑炎、脑膜脑炎伴脑积水和无菌性脑膜炎的儿童的临床特征和短期结果。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究报告称,通过适当的抗菌药物和 抗病毒药物 治疗、特定病例的免疫调节以及有指征时的神经外科干预,所有儿童的病情均得到改善。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为表明,部分免疫的儿童群体中继续发生与腮腺炎相关的严重中枢神经系统疾病,并且可能与大量发病率相关。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要保持 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹 (MMR) 疫苗 的高覆盖率,确保神经系统并发症的早期识别和综合管理,并加强印度 麻疹 腮腺炎 暴发 的治疗。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和缺乏详细统计分析的限制,但由于明确的临床结果和现实世界 暴发 的背景,证据是强有力的。

papers.full_text: Tobacco tax reform resultsRecent tobacco tax reforms in low- and middle-income countries are demonstrating how higher excise taxes can reduce smoking while generating revenue for health and development. A new analysis of 15 countries found that all improved cigarette taxation between 2009 and 2025, with the strongest results achieved through substantial tax increases, simpler tax systems and measures to prevent tobacco products from becoming more affordable over time. The Philippines recorded real cigarette price increases of more than 600% and noted that tobacco-tax reforms helped finance the expansion of universal health coverage. Bangladesh, Brazil, India, Mexico and Pakistan also reported notable declines in tobacco use. The findings support WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative, which encourages countries to increase the real prices of tobacco, alcohol and sugary drinks by 2035 to reduce noncommunicable diseases and create sustainable domestic resources for health and development https://bit.ly/3W8WJ7f Cover photoMaru recycles used lead-acid batteries at his workshop in Lideta, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. World Cervical Cancer Elimination Day. https://bit.ly/4hXGIbB Political declaration for pandemic preparednessThe World Health Organization (WHO) has welcomed the adoption by the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) of a new Political declaration on pandemic prevention, preparedness and response, reaffirming global commitment to protect future generations from the impacts of pandemics.The declaration follows discussions at the second UNGA High-level Meeting on pandemic prevention, preparedness and response and builds on progress made since the COVID-19 pandemic, including the adoption of the WHO Pandemic Agreement. It calls for sustained investment to strengthen national, regional and global capacities to prevent, detect and respond to future health threats. Key priorities include enhancing surveillance systems, implementing the amended International health regulations (2005), supporting equitable access to vaccines and other health products, expanding regional manufacturing capacity and securing sustainable financing. Particular emphasis was placed on concluding negotiations on the Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing (PABS) annex. “The world has come a long way since COVID-19. We urge countries to now fulfil the commitments they have made, especially to finalize negotiations on the PABS annex, so the WHO Pandemic Agreement can be opened for signature, begin the process of ratification and enter into force as international law,” said WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. https://bit.ly/47TuMCY Famine risk in SudanThe Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) has warned of a growing risk of famine in parts of Sudan, particularly in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan, where ongoing conflict, mass displacement, severe drought and inadequate humanitarian funding are driving a rapidly worsening crisis. A drought affecting around half the country is further reducing food availability, increasing prices and undermining livelihoods. The alert highlights alarming levels of acute food insecurity and malnutrition while limited access to health care and clean water leaves vulnerable populations at heightened risk of disease and death. WHO continues to support health and nutrition services across Sudan, including treatment of children with severe acute malnutrition and response to outbreaks such as cholera and measles. Between January and August 2026, more than 26 000 children received treatment through nutrition stabilization centres supported by WHO. With only 23% of its humanitarian appeal funded, WHO is calling for increased funding, sustained humanitarian access and urgent action to prevent further deterioration of the situation.https://bit.ly/4s41yuB Community-based mental health careWHO has released a new guide to help countries transition from long-term institutional mental health care to person-centred, community-based services that respect people’s rights, dignity and choices. The guidance supports the process of deinstitutionalization, helping people who have spent extended periods in psychiatric hospitals return to their communities with access to housing, health care, social services, education and employment opportunities. Supporting the transition to community-based mental health and social care provides practical recommendations for reducing long-term hospital stays, strengthening rights-based care and supporting community reintegration. Despite growing efforts to expand community mental health services, progress remains uneven. According to WHO’s Mental health atlas, only 9% of reporting countries have fully transitioned to community-based care, while more than half remain in the early stages of reform. The guide also emphasizes the importance of involving people with lived experience in shaping mental health policies and services. “Shifting towards community-based mental health care must be done with people who know what it means to go through institutional care, not for them,” said Grace Gatera, independent lived experience consultant and advocate. “Their expertise, alongside that of others, is essential to building services that support choice, recovery and participation in community life.” https://bit.ly/4ijPt0Y First childhood obesity guidelinesResponding to a sharp rise in obesity worldwide, WHO has released its first guidelines on the integrated management of obesity in children and adolescents. In 2024, an estimated 170 million people aged 5–19 years were living with obesity, with prevalence in this age group having quadrupled since 1990. The guidelines emphasize that obesity is a chronic disease requiring timely, evidence-based and person-centred care. WHO strongly recommends structured interventions combining healthy diets, physical activity and behaviour change, delivered individually or through comprehensive programmes. For younger children, the Organization does not recommend medicines, surgery or weight-loss devices, while these options may be considered for adolescents only under strict conditions.The guidelines also highlight the importance of addressing mental health alongside obesity and call for broader policy measures to improve access to healthy diets and physical activity. “The foundation of obesity care for children and adolescents is not medicine or surgery, but access to comprehensive support that enables healthy eating, physical activity and sustainable behaviour change,” said Luz María De Regil, director of WHO’s Department of nutrition and food safety. https://bit.ly/4hM6SPF Together for science and healthWHO has launched a global call for organizations and institutions to join Together for science and health, a new movement aimed at strengthening the relationship between science, health and society and building trust in evidence-informed decision-making. The initiative recognizes the transformative role of science in improving health, from advances in vaccination and antimicrobial treatments to progress in HIV care, cancer prevention and child survival. It seeks to bring together researchers, health professionals, policy-makers, communities, funders and citizens to ensure that scientific knowledge is translated into better health outcomes for all. Built around three pillars, science and society, science and policy, and science communication, the movement will promote collaboration across sectors, support the use of evidence in health decision-making and encourage meaningful engagement with communities. It also aims to improve public understanding of science and strengthen responses to misinformation and disinformation. https://bit.ly/4rZGXaB Global health estimatesGlobal life expectancy has largely recovered to pre-pandemic levels, reaching 73.3 years in 2023, according to WHO’s latest Global health estimates. However, healthy life expectancy has recovered more slowly, highlighting the need not only to extend life, but also to improve health in later years. The new estimates, covering trends from 2000 to 2023, show a continuing shift in the global burden of disease towards noncommunicable diseases, which accounted for 74% of all deaths in 2023, up from 58% in 2000. Cardiovascular diseases remain the leading cause of death worldwide, while diabetes, dementia, mental health conditions and drug use disorders are becoming increasingly important contributors to ill health and mortality. For the first time, communicable diseases accounted for less than half of all deaths in low-income countries, reflecting a major epidemiological transition. “Living longer is one of the great achievements of public health,” said Alain Labrique, director of WHO’s Department of data, digital health, analytics and AI. “The next challenge is to ensure that those additional years are lived in good health, while health systems are equipped to respond to the changing needs of populations.”https://bit.ly/4i1FDzC

papers.title_original: Public health round-up.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the impact of tobacco tax reforms on reducing smoking rates and generating revenue for health and development in low- and middle-income countries, building on the WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A new analysis of 15 countries examined tobacco tax reforms between 2009 and 2025, focusing on real price increases and their effects on tobacco use, with particular emphasis on the Philippines and other nations that reported notable declines in tobacco use.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed data on cigarette taxation and price changes across 15 countries, including real price increases and the implementation of measures to prevent tobacco products from becoming more affordable over time.
analysis.main_results: Bangladesh, Brazil, India, Mexico and Pakistan reported notable declines in tobacco use, while the Philippines recorded real cigarette price increases of more than 600% and noted that tobacco-tax reforms helped finance the expansion of universal health coverage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings support the WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative by demonstrating that substantial tax increases, simpler tax systems and measures to prevent affordability can effectively reduce tobacco use and generate revenue for health and development.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide evidence for the effectiveness of tobacco tax reforms in reducing smoking rates and supporting health financing, which can inform public health policies and interventions in low- and middle-income countries.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported data and does not include detailed statistical analyses or controls, but the evidence is strong due to the consistent findings across multiple countries and the alignment with WHO initiatives.

analysis.summary_en: This analysis evaluates the impact of tobacco tax reforms in low- and middle-income countries, showing that substantial tax increases, simpler systems and affordability measures have led to declines in tobacco use. The Philippines recorded over 600% real price increases, supporting the WHO’s 3 by 35 Initiative. papers.title: Opportunities, Challenges and Proposed Solutions in Responding to Vaccine Preventable Disease Outbreaks in Humanitarian Settings
papers.abstract: Humanitarian crises increasingly disrupt immunization systems, accelerating transmission of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs). Despite a robust global response architecture, reactive vaccination campaigns in humanitarian settings remain poorly documented, frequently delayed, and operationally constrained. We conducted a structured search of published and grey literature to identify and describe reactive vaccination campaigns for five VPDs, including measles, poliomyelitis, diphtheria, meningococcal meningitis, and yellow fever, across humanitarian settings between 2015 and 2024, drawing on 316 published and grey literature sources including WHO Disease Outbreak News, GOARN, and ReliefWeb. Given substantial gaps in publicly available reporting, findings are presented as a perspective to document implementation gaps and draw practical lessons rather than as a systematic review. Of 132 identified outbreaks, reactive vaccination campaigns were documented in 83 (63%). Where reported, the median response lag was 96 days (range: 14–533). Coverage data were available for 26 outbreaks (20%), ranging from 3.7% to 109%. Implementation barriers include political and security constraints, governance and coordination failures, community hesitancy and mistrust, and operational and technical breakdowns. Documented innovations included real-time digital monitoring, diplomatically negotiated access, community-led delivery, and adaptive multi-agency coordination. Despite existing global vaccination mechanisms, critical gaps in documentation, timeliness, and coverage persist. Closing these gaps requires standardized minimum reporting, pre-established coordination frameworks with defined decision authority, embedded community engagement, and context-specific operational guidance tailored to distinct humanitarian contexts. Systematizing and funding field-proven solutions is essential to protect the most vulnerable populations and strengthen global health security.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于对已发表文献和灰色文献(包括世界卫生组织疾病 暴发 新闻、GOARN 和 ReliefWeb)的结构化搜索,旨在识别和描述 2015 年至 2024 年间跨人道主义环境中五个 VPD(包括 麻疹)的反应性 疫苗接种 活动。总共分析了 316 个来源,但由于公开报告中的空白,该综述并未作为系统综述呈现。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在人道主义环境中,麻疹 和其他 VPD 的反应性 疫苗接种 活动经常被延迟且操作受到限制。中位反应滞后为 96 天(范围:14-533),覆盖率数据仅适用于 20% 的 暴发,范围为 3.7% 至 109%。这些发现凸显了改进文档和运营策略的必要性。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了弥补这些差距,审查建议需要标准化的最低限度报告、具有明确决策权的预先建立的协调框架、嵌入式社区参与以及针对不同人道主义背景的具体情况行动指南。系统化并资助经过实地验证的解决方案对于保护弱势群体和加强全球卫生安全至关重要。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本次审查重点关注人道主义环境中应对 暴发 和 疫苗 可预防疾病 (VPD) 的挑战和机遇,特别强调 麻疹病毒。核心问题是如何改进这些背景下反应性 疫苗接种 活动的记录、及时性和覆盖范围。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述基于对已发表文献和灰色文献(包括世界卫生组织疾病 暴发 新闻、GOARN 和 ReliefWeb)的结构化搜索,旨在识别和描述 2015 年至 2024 年间跨人道主义环境中五个 VPD(包括 麻疹)的反应性 疫苗接种 活动。总共分析了 316 个来源,但由于公开报告中的空白,该综述并未作为系统综述呈现。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在人道主义环境中,麻疹 和其他 VPD 的反应性 疫苗接种 活动经常被延迟且操作受到限制。中位反应滞后为 96 天(范围:14-533),覆盖率数据仅适用于 20% 的 暴发,范围为 3.7% 至 109%。这些发现凸显了改进文档和运营策略的必要性。

papers.title: Contact coverage, content of care and inequality in antenatal care and routine immunisation in rural Uttar Pradesh, India: a repeated cross-sectional analysis of household surveys and direct observations of community health sessions.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Community-based primary care aims to reduce geographic and opportunity-cost barriers in rural settings, yet population trends in coverage, content and education-related inequality are poorly described. In rural Uttar Pradesh (UP), monthly community health sessions (Village Health and Nutrition Days (VHNDs)) provide integrated antenatal care (ANC) and routine immunisation (RI). We describe long-term trends in coverage, content and education-related inequality, with direct observation of session readiness. METHODS: We analysed repeated cross-sectional rural UP household survey data from National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-3 (births 2001-2006), NFHS-4 (2011-2016) and NFHS-5 (2018-2020). Outcomes included any and community-level ANC/RI, content-qualified ANC (Antenatal Care Quality (ANCq) ≥8), full RI among children aged 12-23 months and ultrasound use and caesarean birth as facility-dependent comparators. Education-related inequality was quantified using the Slope Index of Inequality and Concentration Index (CIX). Direct observations of 61 133 VHND sessions (2022-2023) described input readiness and observed ANC component delivery. RESULTS: Between 2001 and 2019, any ANC increased from 51.3% to 94.8% and content-qualified ANC from 3.3% to 53.3%. Any RI remained high throughout; full RI increased from 20.8% (2004) to 71.2% (2019). Gains were largest among women with no formal education. Relative inequality narrowed for every indicator and fell close to zero for services deliverable at community level (CIX 0.502 to 0.059 for ANCq, 0.269 to 0.018 for full RI), while remaining substantial for caesarean birth (0.394 to 0.257). Sessions showed high blood pressure and haemoglobin testing capacity and strong availability for key antigens, with lower but improving urine testing and measles-rubella vaccine supply. CONCLUSIONS: Content-qualified ANC and full immunisation improved markedly, with the largest gains among the least educated women and relative inequality narrowed for every indicator except caesarean birth. Where community-deliverable services have converged across education groups, the remaining gap lies in facility-dependent care. Further gains likely depend on referral, transport and surgical capacity rather than extending first-contact outreach.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基于社区的初级保健旨在减少农村地区的地理和机会成本障碍,但对覆盖范围、内容和教育相关不平等方面的人口趋势描述甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在北方邦 (UP) 农村地区,每月举行的社区健康会议(村庄健康和营养日 (VHND))提供综合产前护理 (ANC) 和常规免疫 (RI)。我们通过直接观察会议准备情况来描述覆盖范围、内容和教育相关不平等的长期趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 我们分析了来自全国家庭健康调查 (NFHS)-3(2001-2006 年出生)、NFHS-4(2011-2016 年)和 NFHS-5(2018-2020 年)的重复横截面农村 UP 家庭调查数据。使用不平等斜率指数和集中指数(CIX)对与教育相关的不平等进行量化。对 61 133 个 VHND 会议(2022-2023 年)的直接观察描述了输入准备情况和观察到的 ANC 组件交付。
elements_zh.main_results: 2001年至2019年间,任何ANC从51.3%增加到94.8%,内容合格的ANC从3.3%增加到53.3%。任何 RI 自始至终都保持在高位;完整 RI 从 20.8% (2004 年) 增加到 71.2% (2019 年)。未受过正规教育的女性获得的收益最大。每项指标的相对不平等程度均有所缩小,社区层面可提供的服务的相对不平等程度接近于零(ANCq 的 CIX 为 0.502 至 0.059,完全 RI 的相对不平等为 0.269 至 0.018),而剖腹产的相对不平等程度仍然很高(0.394 至 0.257)。会议显示了高血压和血红蛋白检测能力以及关键抗原的强大可用性,尿液检测和 Z​​XQTERMZQXZ-风疹 疫苗 供应量较低但有所改善。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 符合内容的非国大和全面免疫率显着改善,其中受教育程度最低的女性获得的收益最大,除剖腹产外,所有指标的相对不平等程度均有所缩小。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果谨慎地为改善社区卫生服务和减少与教育相关的医疗服务不平等的策略提供依据,特别是针对 麻疹 和其他 疫苗 可预防疾病。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告与研究设计或数据收集方法相关的局限性。

METHODS: We analysed repeated cross-sectional rural UP household survey data from National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-3 (births 2001-2006), NFHS-4 (2011-2016) and NFHS-5 (2018-2020). Outcomes included any and community-level ANC/RI, content-qualified ANC (Antenatal Care Quality (ANCq) ≥8), full RI among children aged 12-23 months and ultrasound use and caesarean birth as facility-dependent comparators. Education-related inequality was quantified using the Slope Index of Inequality and Concentration Index (CIX). Direct observations of 61 133 VHND sessions (2022-2023) described input readiness and observed ANC component delivery. RESULTS: Between 2001 and 2019, any ANC increased from 51.3% to 94.8% and content-qualified ANC from 3.3% to 53.3%. Any RI remained high throughout; full RI increased from 20.8% (2004) to 71.2% (2019). Gains were largest among women with no formal education. Relative inequality narrowed for every indicator and fell close to zero for services deliverable at community level (CIX 0.502 to 0.059 for ANCq, 0.269 to 0.018 for full RI), while remaining substantial for caesarean birth (0.394 to 0.257). Sessions showed high blood pressure and haemoglobin testing capacity and strong availability for key antigens, with lower but improving urine testing and measles-rubella vaccine supply. CONCLUSIONS: Content-qualified ANC and full immunisation improved markedly, with the largest gains among the least educated women and relative inequality narrowed for every indicator except caesarean birth. Where community-deliverable services have converged across education groups, the remaining gap lies in facility-dependent care. Further gains likely depend on referral, transport and surgical capacity rather than extending first-contact outreach.

papers.title: Viral Immunomodulation as a Potential Driver of Trained Immunity: Emerging Mechanisms of Innate Immune Memory and Antiviral Protection
papers.abstract: The discovery of trained immunity has challenged the longstanding view that immunological memory is restricted to the adaptive immune system. Trained immunity refers to the capacity of innate immune cells to undergo long-term functional reprogramming following exposure to microbial, endogenous, or environmental stimuli, resulting in enhanced responses to subsequent challenges. Trained immunity is mediated by epigenetic and metabolic remodeling, including changes in chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and cellular metabolism. Recent studies further demonstrate that these memory-like properties can also be established in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), providing a basis for their long-term persistence. While Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) and β-glucan are the best-characterized inducers of trained immunity, increasing evidence indicates that viral infections and viral vaccines can also induce durable innate immune reprogramming. Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with vaccinia, measles, and oral polio vaccines, while cytomegalovirus infection and severe SARS-CoV-2 infection have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function. Notably, many of these viruses possess potent immune evasion mechanisms that suppress interferon signaling, modulate NF-κB activation, disrupt antigen presentation, and alter myeloid cell function. We propose that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. This review summarizes the historical development and molecular basis of trained immunity and examines emerging evidence linking viral infections and viral vaccines to innate immune memory. We further discuss the potential roles of virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs as mechanistic bridges connecting viral infection, immune reprogramming, and trained immunity. Understanding how viral infections shape innate immune memory may provide new opportunities for antiviral therapies, vaccine design, and broad-spectrum immune protection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore the potential role of viral immunomodulation in driving trained immunity, challenging the traditional view that immunological memory is exclusive to the adaptive immune system. The background highlights the need to understand how viral infections and vaccines might influence innate immune memory.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature on viral immunomodulation and its connection to trained immunity, focusing on measles virus and related entities. It examines the molecular mechanisms and epidemiological evidence linking viral infections to innate immune memory.
analysis.methods: The methods involve a comprehensive analysis of scientific literature, including epidemiological studies and molecular mechanisms, to evaluate how viral infections and vaccines induce durable innate immune reprogramming. The review also discusses potential mechanistic bridges such as virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs.
analysis.main_results: Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with measles, measles virus genotype B3, and measles virus genotype D8, while viral infections have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. This is a novel perspective that expands the understanding of innate immune memory beyond traditional inducers like BCG and β-glucan.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings may inform new opportunities for antiviral therapies, vaccine design, and broad-spectrum immune protection, particularly in the context of measles virus and its related genotypes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a review of existing literature and does not include new experimental data, which may limit the strength of the conclusions. However, the evidence is derived from multiple sources and is considered moderate in strength.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the emerging concept of viral immunomodulation as a driver of trained immunity, challenging the traditional view that immunological memory is exclusive to the adaptive immune system. It highlights the potential roles of measles virus and related genotypes in inducing durable innate immune reprogramming through mechanisms such as immune evasion and metabolic changes. The study suggests that viral infections and vaccines may influence innate immune memory, offering new insights into antiviral therapies and vaccine design. While the findings are based on existing literature and are considered moderate in strength, they provide a foundation for further research into the interplay between viral infections and innate immune memory.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索病毒免疫调节在驱动训练有素的免疫力方面的潜在作用,挑战免疫记忆是适应性免疫系统独有的传统观点。背景强调需要了解病毒感染和 疫苗 如何影响先天免疫记忆。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾了有关病毒免疫调节及其与训练免疫的联系的现有文献,重点关注 麻疹病毒 和相关实体。它研究了将病毒感染与先天免疫记忆联系起来的分子机制和流行病学证据。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及对科学文献的全面分析,包括流行病学研究和分子机制,以评估病毒感染和 疫苗 如何诱导持久的先天免疫重编程。该综述还讨论了潜在的机制桥,例如病毒诱导的自噬和长非编码 RNA。
elements_zh.main_results: 流行病学研究已证明与 麻疹、麻疹病毒 基因型 B3 和 麻疹病毒 基因型 D8 相关的异源保护作用,而病毒感染与先天免疫功能的长期改变有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,病毒免疫逃避和免疫调节策略可能通过触发感染消退后持续存在的补偿性代谢、表观遗传和转录重编程来促进训练有素的免疫力。这是一个新颖的视角,扩展了对先天免疫记忆的理解,超越了卡介苗和β-葡聚糖等传统诱导剂。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为 抗病毒药物 疗法、疫苗 设计和广谱免疫保护提供新的机会,特别是在 麻疹病毒 及其相关基因型的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于对现有文献的回顾,不包括新的实验数据,这可能会限制结论的强度。然而,证据来自多个来源,被认为强度中等。

analysis_en.methods: The methods involve a comprehensive analysis of scientific literature, including epidemiological studies and molecular mechanisms, to evaluate how viral infections and vaccines induce durable innate immune reprogramming. The review also discusses potential mechanistic bridges such as virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs.
analysis_en.main_results: Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with measles, measles virus genotype B3, and measles virus genotype D8, while viral infections have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. papers.title_zh: 病毒免疫调节作为训练免疫的潜在驱动力:先天免疫记忆和 抗病毒药物 保护的新兴机制
papers.source_body_en: The discovery of trained immunity has challenged the longstanding view that immunological memory is restricted to the adaptive immune system. Trained immunity refers to the capacity of innate immune cells to undergo long-term functional reprogramming following exposure to microbial, endogenous, or environmental stimuli, resulting in enhanced responses to subsequent challenges. Trained immunity is mediated by epigenetic and metabolic remodeling, including changes in chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and cellular metabolism. Recent studies further demonstrate that these memory-like properties can also be established in hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), providing a basis for their long-term persistence. While Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) and β-glucan are the best-characterized inducers of trained immunity, increasing evidence indicates that viral infections and viral vaccines can also induce durable innate immune reprogramming. Epidemiological studies have demonstrated heterologous protective effects associated with vaccinia, measles, and oral polio vaccines, while cytomegalovirus infection and severe SARS-CoV-2 infection have been linked to long-lasting alterations in innate immune function. Notably, many of these viruses possess potent immune evasion mechanisms that suppress interferon signaling, modulate NF-κB activation, disrupt antigen presentation, and alter myeloid cell function. We propose that viral immune evasion and immunomodulatory strategies may promote trained immunity by triggering compensatory metabolic, epigenetic, and transcriptional reprogramming that persists after resolution of infection. This review summarizes the historical development and molecular basis of trained immunity and examines emerging evidence linking viral infections and viral vaccines to innate immune memory. We further discuss the potential roles of virus-induced autophagy and long non-coding RNAs as mechanistic bridges connecting viral infection, immune reprogramming, and trained immunity. Understanding how viral infections shape innate immune memory may provide new opportunities for antiviral therapies, vaccine design, and broad-spectrum immune protection.
papers.abstract_zh: 训练有素的免疫力的发现挑战了长期以来的观点,即免疫记忆仅限于适应性免疫系统。经过训练的免疫是指先天免疫细胞在暴露于微生物、内源性或环境刺激后进行长期功能重编程的能力,从而增强对后续挑战的反应。训练有素的免疫是通过表观遗传和代谢重塑介导的,包括染色质可及性、组蛋白修饰和细胞代谢的变化。最近的研究进一步表明,这些类似记忆的特性也可以在造血干细胞和祖细胞(HSPC)中建立,为其长期持续存在提供基础。虽然卡介苗 (BCG) 和 β-葡聚糖是训练有素的免疫的最佳特征诱导剂,但越来越多的证据表明,病毒感染和病毒 疫苗 也可以诱导持久的先天免疫重编程。流行病学研究已证明与痘苗、麻疹 和口服脊髓灰质炎 疫苗 相关的异源保护作用,而巨细胞病毒感染和严重 SARS-CoV-2 感染与先天免疫功能的长期改变有关。值得注意的是,其中许多病毒具有有效的免疫逃避机制,可以抑制干扰素信号传导、调节 NF-κB 激活、破坏抗原呈递并改变骨髓细胞功能。我们认为,病毒免疫逃避和免疫调节策略可以通过触发感染消退后持续存在的补偿性代谢、表观遗传和转录重编程来促进训练有素的免疫力。这篇综述总结了训练免疫的历史发展和分子基础,并研究了将病毒感染和病毒 疫苗 与先天免疫记忆联系起来的新证据。我们进一步讨论了病毒诱导的自噬和长链非编码 RNA 作为连接病毒感染、免疫重编程和训练免疫的机制桥梁的潜在作用。了解病毒感染如何塑造先天免疫记忆可能为 抗病毒药物 疗法、疫苗 设计和广谱免疫保护提供新的机会。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在探索病毒免疫调节在驱动训练有素的免疫力方面的潜在作用,挑战免疫记忆是适应性免疫系统独有的传统观点。背景强调需要了解病毒感染和 疫苗 如何影响先天免疫记忆。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾了有关病毒免疫调节及其与训练免疫的联系的现有文献,重点关注 麻疹病毒 和相关实体。它研究了将病毒感染与先天免疫记忆联系起来的分子机制和流行病学证据。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及对科学文献的全面分析,包括流行病学研究和分子机制,以评估病毒感染和 疫苗 如何诱导持久的先天免疫重编程。该综述还讨论了潜在的机制桥,例如病毒诱导的自噬和长非编码 RNA。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为 抗病毒药物 疗法、疫苗 设计和广谱免疫保护提供新的机会,特别是在 麻疹病毒 及其相关基因型的背景下。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于对现有文献的回顾,不包括新的实验数据,这可能会限制结论的强度。然而,证据来自多个来源,被认为强度中等。

papers.title: Multi-Pathogen Wastewater-Based Epidemiology Before, During, and After the Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games: Monitoring of the Alpine Tourist Sewersheds of the Province of Trento
papers.abstract: Given worldwide advances in wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE), its implementation is also emerging in international sporting events. The WBE application to a major international sporting event held under winter and cold-climate conditions remains unexplored. The Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosted in the Alpine region, provided a unique opportunity to explore the potential of wastewater surveillance during the winter period, when seasonal diseases also drive pathogen circulation. This paper presents the results of the WBE surveillance conducted in the Province of Trento, over six months (November 2025-April 2026) and covering the periods before, during, and after the Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games. A total of 96 wastewater samples were collected from six wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) serving the Fiemme and Fassa valleys, with a total census population of about 29,000 but reaching 143,000 population equivalents during tourist periods. The WBE monitoring involved quantitative analyses of SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, RSV A/B, and Norovirus GI/GII, as well as screening for measles. Norovirus GI/GII and RSV A/B circulated as the number of event-related visitors increased, whereas SARS-CoV-2 and influenza viruses remained at background or seasonal levels. Clinical surveillance data in the Province of Trento effectively complemented this multi-pathogen WBE. In conclusion, this experience provided non-invasive, community-wide information and demonstrated the operational feasibility and usefulness of WBE as a multi-pathogen sentinel tool for situational awareness to complement public health surveillance.

papers.title_zh: 基于多病原体废水的 流行病学 2026 年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬奥会和残奥会之前、期间和之后:特伦托省高山旅游污水处理厂的监测
papers.source_body_en: Given worldwide advances in wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE), its implementation is also emerging in international sporting events. The WBE application to a major international sporting event held under winter and cold-climate conditions remains unexplored. The Milano-Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosted in the Alpine region, provided a unique opportunity to explore the potential of wastewater surveillance during the winter period, when seasonal diseases also drive pathogen circulation. This paper presents the results of the WBE surveillance conducted in the Province of Trento, over six months (November 2025-April 2026) and covering the periods before, during, and after the Winter Olympic and Paralympic Games. A total of 96 wastewater samples were collected from six wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) serving the Fiemme and Fassa valleys, with a total census population of about 29,000 but reaching 143,000 population equivalents during tourist periods. The WBE monitoring involved quantitative analyses of SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, RSV A/B, and Norovirus GI/GII, as well as screening for measles. Norovirus GI/GII and RSV A/B circulated as the number of event-related visitors increased, whereas SARS-CoV-2 and influenza viruses remained at background or seasonal levels. Clinical surveillance data in the Province of Trento effectively complemented this multi-pathogen WBE. In conclusion, this experience provided non-invasive, community-wide information and demonstrated the operational feasibility and usefulness of WBE as a multi-pathogen sentinel tool for situational awareness to complement public health surveillance.

papers.title: MULTILEVEL BRAIN DAMAGE IN PAEDIATRIC VIRAL PANENCEPHALITIS: COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS OF STRUCTURAL, METABOLIC AND CONDUCTIVE MR CHANGES
papers.abstract: Panencephalitis following measles and other viral infections is again becoming a clinical problem in children, with a wide spectrum of presentations from mild to rapidly progressive forms [1]. Brain damage in these patients may involve the cortex, deep white matter and brainstem [2], and the structural, metabolic and conducting components of the lesion do not necessarily develop in parallel. Understanding how these components combine is important for choosing the scope of MR examination and for prognosis [3].

papers.title: Prediction of Grape Disease using Deep Learning based on MobileNetV2 and Explainable AI with Grad-CAM for Disease Management
papers.abstract: The grapes production can be affected by diseases that cause changes to the look and state of the leaves and may reduce the quality of the crop if the disease are not detected in time. Even though visual diagnosis is of some help, it depends on the operator's experience and can become difficult when different diseases show similar symptoms. The study presents an image-based approach for predicting and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) for providing a visual explanation. The System can detect four kinds of disease: Black Measles, Black Rot, Healthy, and Isariopsis Leaf Spot. The model produces a distribution of class probabilities and Grad-CAM is used to highlight the parts of the image that are related to the predicted class. A general module based on knowledge then provides information regarding the symptoms, advice on how to manage the disease, and preventive measures for the disease which has been predicted. Having been tested on 903 images, the system achieved 886 correct predictions and 17 incorrect ones, giving an accuracy of 98.12%, a weighted precision of 98.13%,a weighted recall of 98.12%, and a weighted F1-score of 98.12%. The errors that were seen were mostly between Black Measles and Black Rot. The study therefore incorporates prediction, visual explanation, and disease-management information into one workflow, while at the same time recognizing the need for further validation with a wider variety of field images..
authors: Rani Bharat Bansode and Ms. Snigdha Shukla
papers.journal: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology

The system was tested on 903 images and achieved high accuracy in detecting four diseases: Black Measles, Black Rot, Healthy, and Isariopsis Leaf Spot. The model provides class probabilities and highlights relevant image regions, with a general module offering disease management advice. The authors note the system's effectiveness but emphasize the need for further validation with a broader range of field images. papers.abstract_zh: 葡萄的生产可能会受到疾病的影响,这些疾病会导致叶子的外观和状态发生变化,如果不及时发现疾病,可能会降低作物的质量。尽管视觉诊断有一定帮助,但它取决于操作者的经验,并且当不同的疾病表现出相似的症状时可能会变得困难。该研究提出了一种基于图像的预测方法和梯度加权类激活映射(Grad-CAM)以提供视觉解释。该系统可以检测四种病害:黑病麻疹、黑腐病、健康病和白斑病。该模型生成类别概率的分布,并使用 Grad-CAM 突出显示图像中与预测类别相关的部分。然后,基于知识的通用模块提供有关症状的信息、如何管理疾病的建议以及针对已预测疾病的预防措施。经过903张图像的测试,系统实现了886个正确预测和17个错误预测,准确率为98.12%,加权精度为98.13%,加权召回率为98.12%,加权F1分数为98.12%。发现的错误主要发生在 Black 麻疹 和 Black Rot 之间。因此,该研究将预测、视觉解释和疾病管理信息纳入一个工作流程,同时认识到需要使用更广泛的现场图像进行进一步验证。

papers.title: Non-Medical Exemptions, Socioeconomic Factors, and MMR Coverage, 2015-2023
papers.abstract: Non-medical exemptions (NMEs) permit children to forgo required school vaccinations for religious or philosophical reasons and have been consistently linked to reduced measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage in prior studies. National coverage fell to 93.1% during the 2022-23 school year, below the 95% threshold needed for herd immunity, and existing literature has not examined multi-year state-level trends in NMEs alongside socio-economic indicators. To address this gap, this study evaluated associations between state-level NME rate, socio-economic factors, and MMR coverage across the United States from 2015 to 2023. It was hypothesized that higher NME rate would be associated with lower MMR coverage and that socio-economic indicators would be significantly associated with NME rate. Pearson correlation and simple linear regression were selected to quantify linear relationships between variables using publicly available state-level data from the CDC SchoolVaxView database and the U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey. Higher NME rate was significantly associated with lower MMR coverage (r = -0.44, p < 0.001), explaining approximately 19.5% of coverage variance. Contrary to expectations and some prior literature suggesting socio-economic barriers reduce vaccination coverage, median household income was positively associated with NME rate (r = 0.13, p = 0.013), while educational attainment (p = 0.578) and health insurance coverage (p = 0.158) were not significant predictors. Average NME rate varied nearly 15-fold across states, from 7.7% in Idaho to 0.5% in the District of Columbia. These findings indicate that exemption behaviors, rather than income-related access barriers, more directly correspond to reduced MMR coverage, particularly in higher-income communities. Interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional, correlational design, potential state-level confounders, and incomplete NME reporting in several states. Future multivariable analyses incorporating policy differences and changes in exemption laws over time could clarify these mechanisms and help guide targeted vaccination outreach and policy interventions.

papers.abstract_zh: 非医疗豁免 (NME) 允许儿童出于宗教或哲学原因放弃所需的学校 麻疹,并且在之前的研究中一直与 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 麻疹 覆盖率的降低有关。2022-23 学年,全国覆盖率下降至 93.1%,低于群体免疫所需的 95% 阈值,并且现有文献没有研究 NME 的多年州级趋势以及社会经济指标。为了解决这一差距,本研究评估了 2015 年至 2023 年美国州级 NME 率、社会经济因素和 MMR 覆盖率之间的关联。假设较高的 NME 率与较低的 MMR 覆盖率相关,而社会经济指标将与 NME 率显着相关。选择皮尔逊相关性和简单线性回归来量化变量之间的线性关系,使用来自 CDC SchoolVaxView 数据库和美国人口普查局美国社区调查的公开州级数据。较高的 NME 率与较低的 MMR 覆盖率显着相关(r = -0.44,p < 0.001),解释了大约 19.5% 的覆盖率方差。与预期和一些先前文献表明社会经济障碍减少 疫苗接种 覆盖率的预期相反,家庭收入中位数与 NME 率呈正相关(r = 0.13,p = 0.013),而教育程度(p = 0.578)和健康保险覆盖率(p = 0.158)并不是显着的预测因素。各州的平均 NME 率相差近 15 倍,从爱达荷州的 7.7% 到哥伦比亚特区的 0.5%。这些发现表明,豁免行为,而不是与收入相关的准入障碍,更直接地对应于 MMR 覆盖率的降低,特别是在高收入社区。解释受到横截面相关设计、潜在的州级混杂因素以及多个州不完整的 NME 报告的限制。未来的多变量分析结合政策差异和豁免法随时间的变化可以澄清这些机制,并有助于指导有针对性的 疫苗接种 外展和政策干预。

papers.title: Edukasi Tenaga Medis dan Non-Medis dalam Mencegah Wabah Campak di Rumah Sakit Islam Sultan Agung
papers.abstract: Campak disebabkan oleh infeksi virus Measles yang sangat menular dan dapat menimbulkan wabah. Campak menyebabkan gejala seperti demam, ruam, konjungtivitis, batuk pilek, dan bercak Koplik. Campak dapat sembuh sendiri/self limited disease, namun bisa menimbulkan komplikasi berat. Indonesia merupakan negara berkembang dengan angka kasus campak 10 tertinggi di dunia pada tahun 2026. Rumah sakit merupakan salah satu tempat yang berpotensi terjadi penularan dan wabah campak. Tujuan kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini adalah meningkatkan pengetahuan petugas medis dan non-medis sebagai garda terdepan pelayanan kesehatan di rumah sakit terkait kasus campak. Metode yang digunakan meliputi pengisian data responden dan soal pre-test, penyuluhan kesehatan, praktik kebersihan tangan sebagai kewaspadaan standar, diskusi dan tanya jawab, serta diakhiri dengan pengisian post-test oleh responden. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan adanya peningkatan pengetahuan responden dilihat dari peningkatan rerata nilai post-test yaitu 97,36 dibandingkan rerata nilai pre-test yaitu 87,42. Hasil uji Wilcoxon menunjukkan nilai p=0,000 (p<0,05), terdapat peningkatan pengetahuan yang signifikan setelah edukasi kesehatan. Kegiatan ini menunjukkan bahwa kegiatan edukasi dapat meningkatkan pengetahuan petugas medis dan non-medis terkait pencegahan penyakit campak di rumah sakit.

papers.title: Household Headship and Inequality of Opportunity in Child Nutrition and Immunisation Coverage in India
papers.abstract: This study explores the inequality of opportunity in nutrition and immunisation coverage among Indian children, with particular attention to household headship, using the most recent National Family Health Survey (NFHS)-5 (2019–2021) on children’s health indicators. Children’s health status was assessed through indicators such as stunting (height-for-age Z -score < −2), wasting (weight-for-height Z -score < −2), being underweight (weight-for-age Z -score < −2) and immunisation coverage (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin (BCG) vaccine, diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis (DTaP) vaccine, polio vaccine and measles vaccine). Children aged 0–59 months were included for nutritional assessment, and those aged 12–23 months were considered for immunisation. The study constructs the Human Opportunity Index to measure the inequality of opportunity considering household headship and employs Shapley decomposition to analyse the contributing factors to such an inequality. The findings reveal that households headed by women are more vulnerable to stunting in children compared to those led by men. Furthermore, children from the higher-income groups were observed to have a much lower chance of experiencing stunting, wasting or being underweight. Wealth status is also positively and significantly associated with immunisation coverage. The study shows that household wealth significantly shapes children’s health opportunities, reducing malnutrition and enhancing immunisation outcomes. Sanitation contributes to disparities in nutritional outcomes, particularly among underweight (18.8%) and wasted (17%) children. Religious beliefs were found to influence wasting in children (16.9%) and immunisation choices of households (21.8%), while female-headed households show modest effects (4% on wasting, 1.3% on stunting).
